dharaniSamgrahaSections.titleIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (4): mānuṣāsuraguruḍagandharvvaśca lokobhagavato bhāṣita matyandāmmiti
paragraphsIast: rakṣaśāmaḥ catuvaktrābhavatu'haṃ ||6|| paramagu ruvajācārythaḥ vajaghaṇḍadharaḥ śubhaḥ|| prajñā- jñānasamāliptaḥ
sarvatathāgatodbhava ||7|| rāśmedbhava gagaṇagañaṇaṃ kritigardabhara kṣudvayaḥ karṇṇodbhavajapāṇijivāhāyātulokeśvaraṃ
manātbhakamañajarṇā-paṃkāyasarvvaśīvaraṇāvi-śaṃbhasvātajāyatemaitrīyaṃ vījasyasamantrabhadraṃ-||9
tujihinajarnmamadhyaskāyamamamaḥ andhontumharājanapātālasaṃskitā-āntakaṃ vāmatuja-aparājitāṃmukhehayaṃ
grīvāyaṃgutke-amitakṣuṇuli||10|| aveladahivāhū-tarkkirājanīladaśuda hijavāmajā numahāvaraḥ ||11
uṣliṣacakravarlisvargamadhyaskāyamamanaḥ andhontumharājanapātālasaṃskitā-ahaṃ|| || adhaprajñāpāramitāyā
vācācatudevasamodbhavarāmakegarbhavanābhaṃ ākāśomeghamaṇḍalaṃ ||13|| māharatiśagadveṣaratimāmakirāga
ratipāṇurādevītārāvajarati||14|| pṛthvīvīrocatākṣoḥ āpadhaghātumāmakiṃtejapāṇucāśvaivavāyu

pta styadhvavyave skitaḥ sarvvabūddhairapi prajñāpāramitā jibhya anūttarāyā samyakaṃsaṃ bodhaumabhisaṃbuddhā tasmāttasmākarhi kūlapūtra jñātavyaṃ prajñāpāramitā maṃtra mahāvidyāmaṃtra| anūttaromaṃtra asomaṃtra asamasamāmaṃtra sarvaduḥkha prasamanāmaṃtra sabhyama dhyātvāt prajñāpāramitā yāyūtkomaṃtra tadayathā|| oṃ gategate pāragatepāra saṃgatebaudhi svāhā|| evaṃ śāripūtra gambhīrāyā gambhīrāyā prajñāpāramitāyāṃ| nikṣitavyaṃ bodhisatvena mahāsatvena| atha khalalū bhagavāna samādhi vyūcchāya āryyāva lokiteśvareṇa bodha-isatvena mahāsatvena sādhū kāramadāta|| sādhū sādhū kūlapūtra evameta tagambhīrāyaṃ prajñāpāramitāyaṃ nnidiṣṭaṃ tadanumodaya sarvvatta tathāgatairiti| idamabhadaucadbha gavonmānta manā-āyūṣmoccha ripūtra āryyāva lokiteślavaraṇa bodhisatvana mahāsatvena sovesarvā vatīvarṣśadeva

mānuṣāsuraguruḍagandharvvaśca lokobhagavato bhāṣita matyandāmmiti|| || āryya pacavigaṃtikā prajñāpāramitā nāmadhāraṇī parisamāpta|| ye dharmmā ityādi|| || oṃ namo bhavatyai āryya prajñāpāramitārye|| evaṃ mayā śruta meka sminsamaye bhagavānrājagṛhe viharatisma| gṛddhekūṭyeparvvatemahatā bhikṣusaṃghaśataicanekaircbodhisatvakoṭī niyutaśata sahasraḥ śakra prakṣya lokepāra pramurkhecane kaiśca deva manuṣāyā sura koṭī śata sahasraiḥ pramukhaiśca parivṛttaḥ|| śrīratna gadarbha (dva) siṃhā sena nisugṇaḥ bhagavā dharmma deśayātisma|| ādoca kalyāṇaṃ madhyekalyāṇa paryyavasāne kalyāṇaṃ svarthaṃsuvyajjanaṃ kevalaṃ paripurṇṇapariśuddha parthyavadātaṃ praṣkacaryya saṃprakāśayatisma| athakhalvāryyā va lokiteśvaro bodhisatvo mahāsatvaḥ utthā(stha) pāśanādekāśaimuttarā saṃgaṃkṛtvā dakṣiṇa jānuma

tvāgṛhe dhāreyiśaṣyāntite sarvvatathāgatā bhaviṣyānti nāgatevvani|| tadayathā|| oṃ jaya padmābhe avame sarasaraṇedhiri dhiri khiri khirāṃ khirira devatārū pāraṇi būddho bhāraśī pūraya bhagavatī sarvvā sāṃmama satvānāgva sarvva kammāviraṇa-āni viśodheya sarvva būddhādhiṣṭhanāṃdhiṣṭhane svāhā|| yaṅmāṃparamārthā prajñāpāramitānsarvva būddhānāṃ jananī bodhisatva mātā satha pāpaharībodhisatva nāyikā sarvva būddherapinaśakate nṛtyaṃśā cakkṣu kalpakoṭī śatairāyi| anapāpaṭhita mātrayā sarvva maṇulābhi sikṣā bhavati| anupā paṭhita mātrayā sarvva maṇulābhi sikṣā bhavati|| sarvvamya maṃ-a'bhimūkhī bhavanti| atha khalvoryyā balo kiteśvaro bodhisattvo mahāsatvo bhagavantametada bocata|| kenakāreṇena bhagavānniyaṃ prajñāpāramitā saṃkṣiptā| bhagavānāha|| aṃtyopāya tvāya pisatvā tsāhaso pīmāṃ prajñāpāramitāṃ svatpākṣaro dhārayiṣyānti vācayiśpanti likhiṣyānti likhāpāyi

ndedharmma rājaṃbhūvanahitakaraṃ viśvatjuṃnāmadheyaṃ||3|| kṣamāvatyāṃprajāto manūjapata sameyāvaśī vivaṃśe āyūrvarṣāyūtāni pravaguṇanidha-esyasya cāsīdvareṇa| jainandrayenasatvatribhavanavadhakaraṃ jñānakhaṇḍeḥ śirīṣavande' haṃsisdadhikārya sūgatamananūmataṃ kravaktruchandammūnīndra||4|| śobhāva tyāṃ dhijānāṃna rapatinihite yonvaye saṃ prasūto yakyāyūnāṃsahasrāṇyatiśaya vapūṣamtri śadāyūrvvabhūva| buddhanvaye narannāca lavaragunino dūyyare prāpta magdhaṃtaṃ vande śāsitāraṃka nakamūnimṛṣiṃdhdhastama dāndhakāraṃ|| vārānasyāṃvṛṣīpākṣi tiyatimahite vipravaṃśe bhijātoyasyatvāyū sahasrāśyātiśaya mahatārdhiśatirvvatsa rāśī|| yenanya godhamūlatribhavaja sanidhiḥ śādhitojñānapiptyātaṃ vande vandanīyaṃma niṣaraṭṭaṣabhaṃ kāśā paloka nāthaṃ|| yojānaḥ śrī viśālaḥ kapita pūravariśākka rājindra

vaṃśeyasyāsīdāyurekaṃśata mihasaradāṃsarvvalokaikabaddhoṣa nirjityāśecca mulesurucimāpisadānunta rāyenavodhistaṃvandeśo sihaṃsurana ranamitaṃ buddhamādityabaṃdhu|| jātiviprapraśaṣṭhu nṛpavaramahite ketumahyāṃgṛhītvā buddhatvaṃyaḥ kariṣyatyāmita guṇanidhirnnāga vṛkṣasyamule| aṣṭāvavdāyutānikṣa pitabhagavate bhāviyagramāyurvvandemaitrayanāthaṃtuṣita puravarāvāskitaṃ taṃmunīndraṃ|| stutvāvi saptabuddhansakalamupagatānsaptasaptārksa bhāsometrayaṃbāṣumaṃmetuṣita puragataṃbhā vitaṃlokanātha| yatpupyaṃsaṃprasuta tubhagatiphala dadahināmeva sarvvācchitvā saṃlkeśayāśo nmunayaśvavarāniṣṭati saṃprayāntu|| itisugatā vadānasapta buddha muni samāptaḥ oṃ namaḥ sarvabuddha bodhisatvānāṃ mulāmūlahālakā nantā sukṣataḥ sarvvajinā-asimaniṣṭha| varadāmamadhantu abhyudā
paragraphsDevanagari: मत्सयमण्डले-॥२॥ आकारथामते देवी प्रज्ञापारमिताशुभः वज्रेसत्वे व्वजो पाप घण्ठ प्रज्ञापार मिता॥३॥

bhakkyā vācayāmi praṇamitā praṇamitā śirasā taṃ mahāyāga sūtraṃ namo buddhā

dharaniSamgrahaSections.titleIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (7): lambaramatrāṁmamasarvvadā anantatasyavayāpadā arara asamantānanta dharmātekhana 3 mahāvīrapastra samasahamahāvarakaṇṇara mahābalokite ha ha ra vajavajārkaradhara rū hūṃ hūṃ maṇulamavarāgra vikamakurutsurūsarvatathā hijyala agrā-agriṇīphaṭ svāhā| imūlavidhāmantrasiddhimādhāraṇī
paragraphsIast: ya namo dharmāya namaḥ saṃghāya|| oṃ namo maṃjūnāthāya|| atha vaja dhanaḥ śrīmāna durdāta damakaḥ paraḥ || triloka vijayī
vīro guhya rādū kuliraśvaraḥ||1|| bibuddha phaṃḍarīkā kṣaḥ prota bhūjña kamalānanaḥ|| projñā layana vajavara svakagraṇa
muhurmahuḥ||2|| bhṛkūṭī taraṃga prabhūkhaira vajapāṇi bhi naṃtaḥ|| udātta damakai vārairvārai bibhatsarupibhiḥ||3
jñālayābhiḥ svakaraiḥ pracchajña vaṇa koṭi bhiḥ|| prajñepāya mahākaruṇā jagadarthakararaiḥ paraiḥ||4|| dṛṣṭhaśuṣṭā śaryebha-ūṃdirteḥ
krārḍhavigraha rupibhiḥ buddha kṛtya karairnāthoḥ sārdhva praṇata vigrahaiḥ||5|| praṇanye nāthaṃ saṃbūddha bhagavaṃta tathāgataṃ
utāṃṇali pūśa bhūtva ida mahāsthitogrataḥ||6|| mā-ī tāyamanārthāya anūkaṃpāya me vibho māyājālābhi sabodhiṃ yathā
lābhī bhavāmyahaṃ||7|| ar-ahānayaṃ kamagrānāṃ kṛśa vyākula vetasāṃhitāya sarva satvā

lambaramatrāṃmamasarvvadā anantatasyavayāpadā arara asamantānanta dharmātekhana mahāvīrapastra samasahamahāvarakaṇṇara mahābalokite ha ha ra vajavajārkaradhara rū hūṃ hūṃ maṇulamavarāgra vikamakurutsurūsarvatathā hijyala agrā-agriṇīphaṭ svāhā| imūlavidhāmantrasiddhimādhāraṇī samāptaḥ oṃ namo buddha-āya|| oṃ namo bhagavate vairocana prabhaketu buddha-āya|| tayathā|| oṃ śuṣkera samayara śānte dānte samā-ū pe-anālaṃvetaramveja sobhavanti mahātejenilālamve nilākūlanirvvāṇesa vve buddhānāṃdhiṣṭhānādhiṣṭhite svāhā| itivaiśacanāmadhāraṇī samākaṃ|| oṃ namo bhagavate āryya śrā-akṣobhyāyatabhāgatā yārhate
paragraphsDevanagari: वैलोचनोद्भव शिरोभववाममखे अभिताभ-अक्षोम्मः ध्वजम वजडघण्ठः रत्ननाभौ अमोघ पाण॥४॥

dharaniSamgrahaSections.titleIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (8): 1) iti akṣobha nāma dhāranī
paragraphsIast: na manttu re phalāpāye||8|| prakāśayatu saṃbddho bhavagāṃ chastā jagad gurūḥ|| mahāsamaye tattvajña iṃdriyaśaya vitparaḥ
bhagavatajñāna satvasy jñāna mūrtaḥ svayaṃ bhuvaḥ|| || gaṃbhīrāthā mūdārārthā mahārthāma samāṃśivā|| ādi
madhyāte katpāśī nāma saṃgīti muttamo||11|| yātī tairbhāṣito buddhai bhīṣiṣpate vakra nāgataiḥ|| pratyūtpanaiśca saṃbūddhairyā
bhāṣate pūnaḥ pūnaḥ ||12|| māyājāle mahātaṃtre yāvasmināṃ pragīyate|| mahāvaja dharai dvaṣṭai ramayai maṃtra dhāribhiḥ
ahaṃ cainā dhārāyiṣyāmi nirpāṇaṃca dṛḍhāśayaḥ|| yathābhavāmpahaṃnātha sarva saṃbūddha guhyadhṛka||14|| prakāśayiṣa-ape
satvānāṃ yathāśaya viśeṣataḥ|| aśeṣa kṛśa nāśāya aśeṣā jñānahānaye||15|| evama dhāṣya guścadro japāṇi
stathāgataṃ|| kṛtāṃli pūṇabhūtvā pakṣa kayasthito grataḥ||6

iti akṣobha nāma dhāranī samāpta|| oṃ namo bhagavate ratneka tu nājāyatamadhāna tāyārhama samyaṃka vjjāya| tayathā oṃ vatte|| mahāvastre ratne saṃbhave svāhā| iti ratne saṃbhavanā dharanī samāpta| oṃ nāmo bhagavate amitāthācā tatha-āgatāyārbhame samyaṃkka buddhāya| tayaṃthā|| oṃ amine' amitobhave amitasiṃddhe amitamini amitagagana kirtīikare sarvāthī siddhe nama savvekarmā kesakasa| kṣayakīra svāhā| iti amitābhasya nāma dhāranī samāpta| oṃ namo bhagavate amoghe siśyu tathāgatā mārhamame samyaṃka buddhāya| tayathā|| oṃ siddhatu bhūmiṃddha parama siddhe svāhā| iti amogha siddhī nāma dhāranī samāpta| oṃ nama dhī majjñā nāthāya| oṃ namo bhagavate| candra vajja kroṭāya| tayathā| bhava| tu, karatu, tiṣṭhatu, vandatu, haratu, amṛteta huṃ, huṃ, ha, phaṭ svāhā|| iti amṛta bhakṣānāma dhāranī samāpta || iti

paragraphsIast: āśiṣaṇā jñāna gāthā ṣoḍaśaḥ ||0|| athaśa-ākyamuni bhargavāna buddhīdvipadottamaḥ nirṇṇamayyāpatāṃ tāṃsvajivhāṃsva
mukhācchubhāṃ||1|| smitaṃsaṃdarśalokā nāma pāyatrayaśodhanaḥ|| trailokya bhāsaka raṇaṃ caturmārāsiśa-āsanaṃ||2
trilokamāpūśyaṃ tyā vrā kṣomadhurayāgirā|| pratyabhāṣata gukṣedra bajapāṇiṃmahā valaṃ||3|| sādhuvajadhanaḥ
śrīmānsādhutevajapāṇaye|| yasatvaṃjagaddhī gaurdhāyamahākaruṇaryonvitaḥ||4|| mahārthāntāma saṃgītiṃ pavitrāmadhanā
śiṃto|| maṃjuśrīmānakāyasthamataḥ śrotuṃsamudayataḥ||5|| tatsādudeśathāmo gha-ahaṃteguskakādhipa| śṛṇutvamekā
gramanāska bhagavāniti||6|| prativacanaṣaṭa|| athaśāṣkamunirbhagavānu sakalamaṃtrakulamahatu|| maṃtravidyādharakulaṃ
vyavalokka kulatrayaṃ|| lokālo

oṃ namaḥ śrīmaṃjunāthāya|| oṃ namo-arapañacanāyamukatidahanadakṣāyamaṃjuśrīpradātāyacandrakāntimaṇibuddhipradāyākhaṅaga pustakavyagrahastāyamaṃjuvāṇivaraprudāyasarvvasatvānāṃñaca śāntiṃkurūpuṣṭikururakṣākurū oṃ āḥ dhīḥ hūṃ phaṭ-svāhā| iti-arapañacanamaṃjuśrīḥ sādhananāmadhāraṇīsamāptaḥ|| oṃ namaḥ śākyasiṃhāya|| tadyathā| oṃ dhṛtiśrutivijayesvāhā|| namostuhabuddhāya suviśuddhabodhayeviśuddhadharmmāpratibhānubuddhe| saddharmma punyāpagatā nuddhayebhavāgraśunpāpariśuddhabuddhaye|| aho aho buddhamanakṣatejasaṃ aho aho sāgaramerū| aho aho buddhamanantagocaraṃ āṃdunvaṃraṃ puṣa-apamivāti dullabhaṃ|| aho aho kāṇikastathāgataḥ śākyakulatunarendrasūryyāyenedṛśaṃbhāṣita- sutramubhumaṃsarvaṣusatvāmanugrahārtha|| śa-ānteśa-avaraḥ śākyamunistathāgataḥ satvobhumaḥ gāntapurepraviṣṭhaḥ

paragraphsIast: ko bhurakulaṃ lokāloka kulaṃ mahata|| mahāmudrākulaṃcāgtaṃmahoṣlīṣa kulaṃ mahat||2|| ṣaṭkulāvalokana gāthā dve
imāṃṣaṇmaṃtrarājānasaṃyuktāmadvayodayāṃ| anutpādadharmiṇī gāthā bhāṣaṃtesma girāpatiḥ||1|| a ā i ī u ū e
ai o au aṃ aḥ|| sthitohṛdi|| jñānamūrttirahaṃ buddhobuddhāṃtryadhvavatirttināṃ||2|| oṃ vajatīkṣaḥ dūḥkhaccheda
prajñājñānamūrttaye|| jñānakāyavāgīśvara arapaścanāthate namaḥ||3|| māyājālābhi saṃbodhikramagāthāstistraḥ||3
prayathā bhagavān buddhaḥ saṃbuddho'kāra sambhavaḥ || akāraḥ sarvavarṇṇāgromahārthaḥ paramākṣaraḥ||1|| mahāprāṇokanutpādo
vā gudāhāravarjitaḥ|| sarvābhilāpa hetvagraḥ sarva vākku prabhāsvaraḥ||2|| mahāmahamahārāgaḥ sarvasatvaratiṃkaraḥ
mahāmahamahādveṣaḥ sarvakleśa mahāripuḥ||3

gambhiśāntā virajāsamādhiḥ yadanva yūṣṭajinabuddha gocare|| śunyā-eva kāyāstabha śvakātāṃ vidhara śūnyādvipakṣekanāṃ te sarva dharmmāḥ prakṛtiśvaśunyāḥ satvāpiśūnyāḥ manūjājūvidyata| nitpajva nityatrya jinaṃsmarā mi nityatrca śovijinasya darśaṇaṣaṣa satataṃca nityaprini ciṃkū sambūddha pūṇyasmaca darśanārtha ṣaṣa skāpthe ha nityaṃ dharaṇīka (ṣa) jāna ati thoka ekosmi jinaraspadarśaṇe odanta kāruṇṣa dvinajaghara tvaṃ-atithoka nṛjbā smisūgata syadarśaṇe|| satāṃroya dvijadāra nityaṃdadā himedarśanatīya śitasaṃ|| satvāḥ satṛṣṇā stavarū pad-rtha| ṇe prajñāya nāṃkarū saṃgha nāyakaḥ davā disedarśaṇa somyarū paṃtvayā hitā tā jagade vadethitaḥ śūnyā śvakāyasta tha śrāvakā nā-āṃkā śanutyā gagaṇa sva- bhāvā|| māyāmarī vyūdaka canprakasā sarvecasatvāḥ sūsvinaḥ svabhāvāmahānna śūnyāḥ svayanāya

sakma || || itisūvarṇtra prabhāyāṃkuleva tā ti samāpta|| oṃ māyā jāla saparivāraye hūṃ|| itimāyājāla mantra gāthā|| ye dharmo-ityādi|| || || oṃ namāmaitrīsiṃhāya|| oṃ namaḥ śrī maitrīyabodhisatvāya mahāsatvāya mahākārakāyakāya| namo bhagavate śākyamunateyetathāgatāyārhate samyakayaṃ buddhāya|| tayathā|| oṃ ajite' mahāmāhisvapāhā|| mati' mahāmahisvāhā|| iti śrī maitrīnātha-ātha|| bhāvaviyāvaraṇa sampannaḥ samyakakaṃ buddhāyasarva satvārtha pravitracikā puṇya dhupa dipa gandhane vidyasaṃsārā duḥ

dharaniSamgrahaSections.titleIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (11): khāṅatanuttarāya sampakkaṁ bodhau pratiṣṭhāya
paragraphsIast: mahāmahamahāmohegūḍha dhīmīhasudanaḥ || mahāmahamahākrodhā mahākrodharipūrmahān ||4|| mahāmahamahālopaḥ
sarvalobhaniṣūdanaḥ|| mahākāmo mahāsaukhyo mahāmohogahāratiḥ||5|| mahārupo mahākāyo mahāvarṇṇo mahāvapūḥ
mahānāmāmahodāro mahāvipulamaṇḍalaḥ||6|| mahāprajñāyu dhadharomahākreśāṃkūlāgraṇīḥ|| mahāyaśā mahākīrttirmahā
jyotirmahādayutiḥ||7|| mahāmāyādharo vidvānamahāmāyārtha sādhakaḥ|| mahāmāyāraniratīmahāmāye vrajālikaḥ||8
mahādonapatiḥ śreṣṭho mahāśīladharograṇīḥ|| mahākrāṃtidharo dhīrī mahāvīrarthyaparākramaḥ||9|| mahādhyāna samādhiṣṭho
mahāprajñāśarīradhṛk|| mahābalomahopāyaḥ praṇidhijñānasāgaraḥ||10|| mahāmaitrī mayomeyomahākāruṇikogradhī
mahāprajñemahādhīmāna mahopāyīmahākṛtiḥ||11|| mahāṛdhibalopeno mahāvegīmahā

khāṅatanuttarāya sampakkaṃ bodhau pratiṣṭhāya|| ji āḥ maitreya hūṃ svāhā| iti maitrīya nāmadhāraṇī samāptaṃ|| || ḍenamaḥ śrīlokanāthāya|| amogha pāśāyanamaḥ|| evaṃmayā śrutamekasmiṃ samaye bhagavān protarakeparvvate viharatisma|| āryyāva lokiteśvaraspabhavane| aneka śāsagatamāsa campakāśa-okātimukta kanānānāratnavṛkṣa samalaṃkṛtemahatābhikṣū saṃghenasārddha aṣṭādaśabhirbhikṣa sahasrairnavanavati bhiścabodhisatva koṭiniyuteśatasahasraiḥ parivṛttaḥ puraskṛta iśvara maheśvara vraphnta kāyikāṃ deva putrā nādha-ikṛtya dharmmadeśayatisma|| athakhalvāryyāca lokiteśvaro bodhisatvo mahāsatvotchāyāsanādekāṃśa muttarā saṅgakṛtvāda kṣiṇajā majulaṃ pṛthiṣyā pratiṣṭha-āpyayenabhagavāṃsta nāñajalīkṛtvāpraṇya prahasita vadano bhūtvā bhagavanta meta davocata|| astima mebhaṃga
paragraphsDevanagari: रक्षशामः चतुवक्त्राभवतुऽहं॥६॥ परमगु रुवजाचार्य्थः वजघण्डधरः शुभः॥ प्रज्ञा- ज्ञानसमालिप्तः

dharaniSamgrahaSections.titleIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (12): na vyuhaṁnāma samādhiṁ prati labhate| yadi-icchati tatkarotyeva śādhaka iti
paragraphsIast: javaḥ|| mahādviko mahāśākhyo mahābalaya parākramaḥ||2|| || mahābhavādrisaṃbhettā mahāvaja dharodhanaḥ||14
mahākrūro mahāraudro mahābhaya bhayaṃkaraḥ||13|| || mahāvidhītamonātho mahāmaṃtrotta māgūra| || || mahāyāna nayābūḍho
mahāyāna nayottamaḥ||14|| vajadhātu mahāmaśalagāthā ceturdaśaḥ||14|| || mahāvairocano buddho mahāmaunī mahā
munīḥ || || mahāmaṃtranayo hūto mahāmaṃtra tayātmakaḥ ||1|| || daśapāramitā prāpto daśapāramitāśruyaḥ
daśapāramitā śuddhirdaśapāramitānayaḥ|| || || daśabhumi śvarānāthoda daśabhumīśvaronātho daśabhūmī pratichitaḥ
daśajñāna viśuddhātmā daśāna viśuddhidhṛkaḥ||3|| || daśākārā daśārthīryo munīṃdro daśabalo vittuḥ|| || aśeṣa
viśvārthakaro daśākāra vaśīmahānu||4|| || anādi niṣprapaṃcātmā śuddhātmā tathatātmakaḥ

athasādhayitumicchannidhiṃ|| paṭṭe'ślekairvarṇḍukairvṛdhva pratimā mālikhyārcyāvalokiteśvaro jaṭāmakūṭa dhāri-eṇeyaca karmma kṛta parivāsāḥ|| paśupati veśadharaḥ sarvvālaṃkāra vibhūṣitaṃ kṛtvā poṣadhikena citrakereṇa citrāya yitavyaṃ| tataḥ sādhanena tasyā grato' patita śobhaye namanulaṃkṛtvā śvetapūṣpā vakīrṇḍu ayogandhodaka pūrṇṇakūmmāḥ skāpayi tathāḥ aṣṭhāvū pahārāśca tuṣeṣṭhirupakareṇānivalimānsa rudhiravarjjitaḥ agurudhūpaṃdahatā vidyā ajrūsahasvaṃ mraṃjāpayitavyāḥ ahorātro pitena vātriśukrabho jinovā triṣkālaṃsnā pitāśucivambhra prāvṛto bhūtvā jāpodātavyaḥ|| tateḥ pratimāyā agrata ātmānaṃ jvalitapaśghatiḥ taṃ dṛṣṭvā prahṛṣyeti yāvta tvayāmevāryyāca lokiteśvara āgachati|| sarvvāsāṃ sāṃparipūrayati| manaḥ silātrtranamvā parijapya akṣīṇyajayitvā|| tato'ntahito bhavati ākāśeḥ krāmati-ayaṃ mohajñā

na vyuhaṃnāma samādhiṃ prati labhate| yadi-icchati tatkarotyeva śādhaka iti|| idamavocad bhagavānāttamanā āryāva lokiteśvaro bodhisatvo mahāsatvastaca bhikṣavastaica bodhisatvā satcaśuddhāvā sakā-īka devapūtrā sadeva mānūṣā saragaruḍa gandharvvaśca lokobha gavatoṣitamabhya nandanniti|| iti āryā smoghapāśanāma hṛdayaṃmahāyāna sūtraṃ nāmadhāraṇāṃ parisamāptaḥ oṃ namaḥ śrīlokanāthāya|| oṃ namaḥ śrīkhasarpyanāyai| trailokya darpyanātha ekāgracittā cittāya sakala lokavināsana karāya sarvasatvānātrya śānti kurupūṣṭiṃ kururakṣā kurusiddhiṃ kuru-oṃ āḥ hṛṃ hu phaṭ svāhā|| āryā khasarpyanāmadhāraṇī samāpta| oṃ namaḥ trailokanātha|| oṃ namo bhagavate āryāva lokiteśvarāya bodhisatvāya mahāsatvāya mahākāruṇikāya|| tadyathā oṃsūmūṣṭi chedani nirmmaresū

dharaniSamgrahaSections.titleIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (13): maṁgale sarvabhayamoceni sarva pāpabhayetyā vimocani| oṁ rājabhayāt| cora bhayāt| maraṇa bhayāt| apasmāra bhayāt| iti bhayāt| skandha| bhayāt agnibhayāt| udakabhayāt| paracakrabhayāt setāmadhṛpa gatovā| cora madhṛpa gatovā| siṁhamadhṛpa gatovā| vyāghrama gatovā| sarvvama gatovā| vāyu madhṛpa gatovā| candrama gatovā| kāsavāmadhṛpa ganovā| nigama madhṛpa gatovā| rajamadhṛpa gatovā| halatī madhṛpa gatovā| samudramadhṛpa gatovā| kānumadhṛpa gatovā| naramadhṛpa gatovā| savaimadhṛpa gatovā| savvaugadraveṣu| mucyate raśtaramāṁ masarvasatvānāyatra āyuro rogyaśiyomutu ārccāvabhoki| tracenasya bhalīra labharvya kṣarerghā praticchībhānāṁmoca| nisiddhīvini| oṁ namaḥ svāhā| āryā abhayaṁ karināma dhāranī
paragraphsIast: dhāriṇīsaṃgraha
bhūtavādī tathāvādī tathākārī ananya vāk||5|| advayau dvayavādī ca bhūta koṭī vyavāstitaḥ nairāmya siṃha nirnādaḥ
kutīrthya mṛga bhīkaraḥ||6|| sarvatra gomogha gatistatha-āgata manojavaḥ jino jitari vijayī cakravarti mahābalaḥ
gaṇamukhye gaṇācāryo gaṇeśo gaṇapatirvaṣā|| mahānubhāvo dhautreyo ananya neyo mahānayaḥ||8
vāgīśovākapatirvāgmī vācasya tiranaṃtagīḥ satyavāka satyavādī ca catraḥ satyopadeśakaḥ||9|| avaivarki kocakra
nāgāmī khaṃgra pratyekanāyakaḥ nānā niryāga niryāto mahābhūtaika kāraṇa||10|| ahaljīṇā śravobhikṣuḥ vītarāgo
jiteṃdriyaḥ lamaprāko bhayaprākaḥ śrī tī bhutocya nāvila||11|| vidyācaraṇa saṃpannaḥ sugato lokavityaraḥ nirmayo
nirahaṃkāraḥ satyadhvaya nayostitaḥ saṃsārapāra koṭisthaḥ kṛtajña

dharaniSamgrahaSections.titleIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (14): verocana vyusarājāpaya tathāgatārhate samyakaṁ buddhāya| tadyathā| nama| sarva tathāgatetatya| samyakaṁ buddhāyatya| namaḥ āryāvajñokī| teśvarāya bodhisatvāya| mahāsatvāya| mahākārūṇikāya| taghayā| oṁ dhara tu dhirītu ṣar-tu bhadrevatu, pracajñetu kusumetu vane| iti bhilici| li vajjālā pranaye svāhā| ārya śrī sabhamra bhujalokeśvarasya nāma dhāranī
paragraphsIast: taṃ sthale sthitaḥ kaivālo jñāna niṣyutaḥ|| prajñāśāstro vidāvaṇaḥ ||13|| saddharmo dharmarāḍa bhāsvān lookā lokakaraḥ
dharmeśvaro dharmmarājāśe yogārgopade śakaḥ|| || siddhārthaḥ siddha saṃkalpaḥ sarva saṃkalpa varjitaḥ
nivikalpokṣayo dhāturddharmadhātuḥ parovyayaḥ|15|| puṇyavāna puṇya saṃbhāro jñānaṃ jñānākara mahat| jñāna vānmada
sadjñānī saṃbhāradvaya saṃbhṛtaḥ||16|| śāśvate viśva rādayo gīdhyānadhyeyo dhiyāṃpātiḥ|| prayatmavai dayo kavalaḥ
paramādaya mtri kāyadhṛka||17|| paṃcakāyātmako buddhaḥ paṃcajñānātmako vituḥ| paṃcabuddhātma mukūṭaḥ paṃcakṣara saṃgadhṛka
janakaḥ sarva buddhāṃnā vad ve putraḥ paśevacaḥ prajñā bhavo dravo yo nirdharmayo nirbhavāṃtakṛta||19|| dhanaikasa
śevajātmā sadyojākṣo jagatyātiḥ gagano bhavaḥ svayaṃbhūḥ prajñā jñānāna lo mahān||20|| vairoca no mahādīptirjñānaṣkāti

paragraphsIast: rvirocanaḥ
jagatpadīpojñāṇoklo mahātejāḥ prabhāsvaraḥ || || biyārājogramaṃtreśī maṃtra rājomahārthakṛta|| mahoblīṣobhutoṣlībo
viśvadarśī viyatyatī||22|| sarvabuddhātāvāgyo jagadānaṃdalocanaḥ|| viśvarūpīvidhātācapuṣkā
mānpomadānmṛṣi||23|| kūlatrayadharomaṃtrīmahāsamayasaṃtradhṛka|| ratnatrayadharaḥ śreṣṭha striyānottama deśa kaḥ||24|| amogha
pāśo vijayī vaja pāśo mahāgrahaḥ|| vaṃjākuśomahāpāśo vajabhairavatīkaraḥ ||25|| suviśuddhadharmadhātuna gāthāḥ
paṃcaviśaṃtiḥ|| krodhanāṭṣaṇmukho bhīmaḥ ṣaṇnaitraḥ ṣaḍbhujāvalī|| daṃṣdrā karālakaṃkālahalāhalaśatānanaḥ||1|| yamāṃta
kovighna rāccavajaveśobhayaṃkara| || viyuṣṭavajohad vajomāyāvajomahodaraḥ||2|| kuliśeśovajayinarvajamaṃḍona
bhopamaḥ|| kuliśeśo jaṭāṭopogajacarmapaṭādradhṛka

paragraphsIast: hāhākāro mahāgharo hīhīkāra bhayānakaḥ|| aṭṭahāso mahāhāso vajahāso mahāvaraḥ|| || vajasatvo mahāsatvo
vajarājo mahāsukhaḥ|| vajacaṇḍa mahāmoho vajahūṃkāra hūṃkṛtiḥ|| || vaṃjavāṇā yūdhadharo vajakhaḍago nikṛṃtanaḥ
viśvavajradharāvajī ekavajī raṇaṃjahaḥ||6|| vajabhālo kalārārthavajabhālo śiroruhaḥ|| vajāveśo mahāveśaḥ
śatāśrīvajalocanaḥ|| || vajaromāṃkurata-rvajaromaika va grihaḥ|| vajakauṣṭhinā vāraṃ bhāvajasāraghanacchaviḥ||8

trailokyeś vara vo mahān|| ākāśadhātuparyante ghoṣoghoṣavatāṃvaraḥ||10|| ādarśanajñāna gāthādaśa|| tatha
mābhūtanairātmābhūtakoṭivara-araḥ| śūnyatāvādīṣṭabhogaṃ

iyaṃ iyamāntra padāvyatikyra bhiṣyanti|| saptadhāsya saptāskārayet tatra imānimantra padāni bhavanti|| tadyathā|| aṇraleḍakrye kokāre| sakṣacinta kesi| tejavatijasavati| namobuddhāya|| namo dharmmaya|| namoḥ saṃghāya|| bhagavate ekāhibjala spapratidyātāya bhāṣyate|| dektibjala pratidyātāja bhāṣetha dehikabjala pratidayātāya bhāṣate| dehikabjala pratidyātāya bhāṣeta| eva deva sikasya muhurmu ha kasirottayasiraḥ akṣīrogasyadanta roga kyamukharogasya| jihṛ rogasya gararogasya| udaraśulastha hṛdaya śulasya| arohikasya visucikasya nāhamānanda samanupaśyami|| satvācāsatva nikāyakaḥ|| ya-imehimanta padāni|| oṃ mājilakuryyāt|| oṃ manipadma hūṃ| dehaskā payitvā|| yatiroma vimarā deva varṣa saṃkhātati sukhāvatī juvaṇeskāpayeta viśeṣa kārtikamāse śukrapakṣe manohare tamekameka paṭhanti koṭī kophṭī tulyāniphalaṃla

paragraphsIast: bhire dāragarjanaḥ ||1|| dharmaśaṃkho mahāśabdo dharmagaṃḍī mahāraṇaḥ|| apratiṣṭita nirvāṇī darśadiśa dharmaduṃdubhiḥ||2
atru vīru pavīnagro nānārūpī manomayaḥ|| sarvarū pāvabhāsa śrīra śoṣaprati vivaṃdhṛka||3|| agradhṛṣyoṃ mahośokhā
traudha-ā-ūka maheśvaraḥ|| samūddhinārtha mārgastho dharma ke u mahodayaḥ ||4|| traulokyai kakumārāgeḥ sthavirī buddhaḥ
prajāpatīḥ|| dvatiśajña ūṇadharaḥ kāṃtakyai loka suṃdaraḥ ||5|| lokejñāna guṇācāryo lokācāryo viśāvadaḥ
nothakyā tā trilokākaḥ śatrarnatā yītirukuraḥ|| || gaganābhoga marbhogaḥ sarvajña jñānabhoganaḥ|| aviśyākra kogebhesajya
bhavapaṃja lahāraṇaḥ||7|| śāmitāgoṣa saṃkreneḥ saṃsārorblapāraṇaḥ|| jñānābhiṣeka mukuṭaḥ samyakasaṃbuddha bhūṣaṇaḥ|| triduḥ

dayā de hita araggame namaḥ siddhiyogīśvara dūdbhyū viryyante mahāviryyadhara dhara dharaṇīśvarakṣara dharaṇīśvarakṣara vimalāmalamūrte| āryyāvalokiteśvara kṛṣṇā jina jaṭā makūṭālaṃkṛta śarīraḥ prabala mahāsiddhi śuddhā dha varamara mala mala mahālamakṣala mahākṣala| kṛṣṇa pakṣa kṛṣṇa varṇu kṛpā sananirdhā tanamaha| padmahastajayaka nikaniśācare| kṛṣṇa sarppa kṛtayajñapavita ehavilāha ti pūla dahaneśvaraḥ|| nārāyanavara nṛpa varṣadhāriḥ he nīlakaṇṭha he mahāharāhara viṣarnita tālokasya rāga viṣa nāsanāna dveṣa vināsana tarmokṣataḥ haru mūṅca mūkya bhūrū harā harā mahā padāna nā bhasara siri surū buddha bodhya tava nīlakaṇṭha ehe hi nīlakaṇṭha ehe hi māmaski ta siṃha mūkhaṃ sahe mūṅca mahā.... hā sa naminādine eha hi bho bho mahā siddhi yogeśvara vandhe vācasādhaya vidyāsma tvaṃ he bhagavan loke stvaṃ tathāgata dadādimedarśe

dharaniSamgrahaSections.titleIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (19): rasapta miśrana saṁyukta ṣaḍakṣarasatva
paragraphsIast: varoniḥ śoṣabhayanāśanaḥ||16|| śikhīśikhaṃḍī jaṭilo jaṭimauṇḍī kirīṭamāna|| paṃcānanaḥ paṃcaśikhaḥ
paṃcavīrakaśekharaḥ ||17|| mahāvratadharāmaujī vrakṣacātrī vrammottamaḥ|| mahātapās taponiṣṭhaḥ srātako gautaśrograṇī
vrakṣavidvākṣaṇo vrakṣā vrakṣa nirvānam āptavāna| mukṣimokṣo vimokṣāṃgoḥ vimuktiḥ śāntatā śi vaḥ
nirvāśanirvṛttiḥ śāṃtiḥ graiyānipāṇamaṃtakaḥ|| sukhaduḥkhāṃta kṛniṣṭho vairāgyamupadhikṣayaḥ||20|| ajayānū
pamoṇa-ayakto nirābhā so niraṃjanaḥ|| niṣkasaḥ sarvago vyāpī śūkṣmo bīja manāścaḥ ||21|| arajo virajo vimalo
vāta doṣo nirāmayaḥ|| suprabuddho vibuddhāt mā sarvajñaḥ sarvavitparaḥ vijānadharmatātīto jñānavaddhayarupadhṛka nirvikalpo
nirābhogaḥ traśva saṃbuddha kāryakṛta||23|| anādinidhano buddhaḥ ādibuddho niranvayaḥ

sarva lokāṃlokānaṃ lokanāthaṃ parama guṇakāraṃ tāraṇī tasya bodhaṃ|| pāndetā driyaṃ sakala samuditāṃ mitratā śratra bhākṣāṃyāyo vācchasa śumoto sukṛta sukhaphalaṃtrā himāṃhaka prabodhaṃ|| yā vajñānāmaya nivibhava samūditāṃ vāstavāta nṛrakṣāka śvitadīrgha suthīnaṃ manu hṛdayathiro pātru bodharmma cintaṃ|| kṣa|| hūṃ hūṃ śāntonayakaccha katha sadṛśetādṛśelokavācchasa ibṭhā| vyodhiya hāraiya ravikata jalo sarvvadā kaṃ vaiyānāṃvaiyanātha atita rakṣatā kāya siddhiṃca kārya khanyuvo āmanoyī yaṣakṛta kathito mitracintā ṇitvāṃ|| || hūṃ|| samyaka buddha mānobhaya sakala hacāṃ lokanātha prabhā vāyatyūśṣaṃ pthyā māno prahasita śunyatā mokṣa lābho|| āyukalyāna herakathita naranarāyā tayā tīvaśeṣyā bhoyānāmā nilābho anurbhala phalanā śṛddhārā dehadevaḥ|| iti prathamokṣa

rasapta miśrana saṃyukta ṣaḍakṣarasatva samāptaḥ|| || oṃ namo lokanāthāya namaste bodhisatvāya mahāsatvāyatāpine| āryyāva lokiteśāya maheśvarāya suśriye||1|| padmaśrī bhuṣitā ya saddharmmavacadāyate namāva śaṃkarāya truvanadṛṣṭika nāyate|| || sarvadā jagadāśvāsavara dāna pradāyaca| śata sahamrahastāya koṭīlakṣekṣaṇāyaca|| || vaḍavā mukha paryyanta śaśidiśāna nāyaca| sarva dharmmānurupāya dharmma priyāṃya suddhiye|| || sarvva satva mahā duḥkha saṃmokṣaṇa karāyaca| matsya dayāmbujūja mṛnāmā śvāsana karāyacaṃ||5|| jñāna rāśṣutta māṃgāya dharmmārtha priyadāyine| ratna śrī bhuṣitāṃtyāya saṅṇa śrī pradāyaca||6|| sarvva naraka bhumīnāṃ saṃśoṣaṇa karāyaca| jñāna śrī saṃprabhāsāya jñāna laṣkī pradāyaca|| sāmaraiḥ sāsurendreśvalokaiḥ saṃpūjitāyaca namaḥ

dharaniSamgrahaSections.titleIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (20): ye vajapāṇi mahāyakṣa vijadaṇakarāyaca
paragraphsIast: jñānaika ca jhara mahojñāna murtista tathāgata| || || vāgīśvaro mahāvādī vādirāḥ vādi pūṃgavaḥ|| vadanāṃvaro variṣṭho
vādisiṃhā parājitaḥ||25|| samaṃtadarśī prāmotha snejomālī sudarśanaḥ|| śrīi vatsaḥ sulapranodīkīrbhābhā surakaraya
tiḥ|| || mahāhiṣāvaraḥ śreṣṭhasyaharkrānirakaraḥ|| aśeṣa bhaiṣa cakranaraḥ kreśavādhi mahāripuḥ||27
trailokotilakaḥ kāṃtaḥ śrīmāna śṛtamaṃḍaleḥ|| daśadigaṃpomapapaino śarmadhva jaso madhekṛyaḥ||28|| rajagacchava treka
vipulo maitrīkarūnamaṃḍalaḥ|| praśanarkṛśvaraḥ śrīmāna ratraccha śvo mahāvikṣuḥ|| || sarva buddho me mahārājaḥ
sarvabuddhātmabhāva dhṛka| sarva buddha mahāyoga|| sarva buddheka śāsana||30|| vajarattābhiṣeka|| śrīsarvavajjā
dhipeśvaroḥ|| sarva lokeśvarapati sarvavajadharodhipaḥ||31|| sarva buddha mahācikra sarva vaśyama

skṛtāya bhaktāya vanditāya nama msadā||8|| abhayaṃdāna pāramitāya deśine| sūryya rocana dīptāya dharmma dīpaṃkarāya ||9|| kāmarūpāya gandharvva surūpāya surūpite| he mana gā dhirū ḍhāya paramārtha viyoga vijrate aṅi gambhīra dharmmāya saṃmukha darśaṇāyaca| sarva samādhi prāptāya svarbhāra tikarāyaca||11|| saṃvicchurita grātrāya muni puṅ va garupiṇe| baddha vandhana varddhanāṃ saṃmokṣaṇa karāyaca||12|| sardva bhāvānurupāya samuvite kāriṇe| vadbha parijanāścaya cintāmaṇi surūpiṇe||13|| nirvvāṇa mārgga sakasasaṃdarśana pradāyaca| bhūta preta picā dinirbhayocheṣakāriṇe|| || chatrī bhutāya lokānāṃ traidhātuka nivāsināṃ| sarvvadhivyādhi muktānāṃ parimocana kāriṇe||1|| nando pa nanda nāgeṃdra pajñāparvātavitrate| śrīmatī mogha pāśasya rupa saṃdarśanāyaca||16|| sarva mantra guṇābhi prāptāya sadguṇādva

ye vajapāṇi mahāyakṣa vijadaṇakarāyaca||17|| trai loke dusatvānī bhīṣaṇa mūrtti dhāriṇe| bhutacetā ekūmbhāṇura kṣoyakṣā dibhī da de|| || nilotyala khunatrāya gambhīcadhīca buddhaye| sarvva dhinā thāya sarvva kle śopāriṇe|| bhūvi vidharmma sambā dhimārgoya citāyaca| mokṣa bhārgā bhiruḍhāya pravaradhamma pitrute|| || prāpta saṃbodhi saccitta sanmārgo pacitāyaca| pretā didurgati kleśa parimokṣaṇa karāyaca||21|| paramoṇu rajo saṃkhya samādhida dhate namaḥ| nama mtrai laukanāthāya bodhisatvāya tesadā|| || mahāsatvāya saddharmma guṇa saṃpaktidāyine| namāmi tejaga chāstā sadāhaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajate||23|| bhajābhisatavaṃbhakkāta tprasadi jagatprabho| kṣanta vyaṃme rādhatvaṃyatmathā prakṛtaṃbhavet||24|| itiśrī madāryyā va lokiteśvara spajamacā jā muti samāptaḥ|| oṃ na mo loka

dharaniSamgrahaSections.colophonIast: ye vajapāṇi mahāyakṣa vijadaṇakarāyaca||17|| trai loke dusatvānī bhīṣaṇa mūrtti dhāriṇe| bhutacetā ekūmbhāṇura kṣoyakṣā dibhī da de|| 18|| nilotyala khunatrāya gambhīcadhīca buddhaye| sarvva dhinā thāya sarvva kle śopāriṇe|| bhūvi vidharmma sambā dhimārgoya citāyaca| mokṣa bhārgā bhiruḍhāya pravaradhamma pitrute|| 20|| prāpta saṁbodhi saccitta sanmārgo pacitāyaca| pretā didurgati kleśa parimokṣaṇa karāyaca||21|| paramoṇu rajo saṁkhya samādhida dhate namaḥ| nama mtrai laukanāthāya bodhisatvāya tesadā|| 22|| mahāsatvāya saddharmma guṇa saṁpaktidāyine| namāmi tejaga chāstā sadāhaṁ śaraṇaṁ vrajate||23|| bhajābhisatavaṁbhakkāta tprasadi jagatprabho| kṣanta vyaṁme rādhatvaṁyatmathā prakṛtaṁbhavet||24|| itiśrī madā ryyā va lokiteśvara spajamacā jā muti samāptaḥ|| oṁ na mo loka

paragraphsIast: nogatiḥ|| sarvabuddha mahākāyaḥ sarvabuddha sarasvatiḥ||32|| vanasūryamahāloka vaveṃdū vimalaprabhaḥ|| virāmādi
mahārāgo viśva vajña ghālaprabhaḥ||33|| saṃ buddha vajaparyako buddha saṃgīti dharmadhrukā| buddhāya odravaḥ śrīmāna sarvajña
jñānakauśa dhrukā||34|| viśva māyā dharā rājā buddha viyodhano mahāna|| vajartī kaumahākhaśo viśuddhaḥ paramākṣaraḥ
duḥkhacchada mahāyānavaja dharṇamahāyudhaḥ|| biṃna jigvajaggaṃ bhīryya vaja budhiryathāṣīvitā sarva pāramitā pūrī
sarva bhūmi vibhuṣaṇaḥ|| viśuddha dharmanerālyaḥ samyaka jñāne dūhatpataḥ|| māyābāsamahādhyāmaḥ sarva maṃtrā dhipaḥ paraḥ
aśeṣa vaja paryakomiḥ śeṣa jñāna kāyadhruka||38|| samaṃta bhadraḥ sumatiḥ kṣiti garbho jaga-utpati|| sarvabuddha mahārbho
viśva nirmāṇavakra dhruka||39|| sarvatā svabhāvā

nāthāya|| namehaṃ bhagavanchāstre va lokite śvarāyate| padmabhṛte maheśāya sū pralhāda karāyaca||1|| padmāsanāya padmaśrī pariṣṭata samūktaye| saṃśubha padmahastāya jagadāśvā sadāyine||2|| pṛthivī carane trāya saṃśuddha patrvacakṣuṣa| jinaratna kirīṭāya cintāmaṇi vibhūṣiṇa||3|| itimaheśvarakṛta stavaḥ|| namehaṃ bhagavanchāstreve lokite śvarāyate| maheśāya jagabhartta prāṇadāya mahātmate||1|| pṛthivīvarane trāyaṃ śubhapadmadharāyaca| padmaśrī pariṣṭatāya sūcetana karāyaca||2|| dharmmadharāya nāthāya daśabhūmīśvarāya cāsū nirvṛtti mahāyāna saṃprasthitāya sarvvadā||3|| iti āryyāvalokiteśvarasya umāmaheśvara kṛtmṇati samāptaṃ||3|| oṃ namaḥ samatra bhadrāya|| atha khalū samanta bhadro bodhisatva mmahāsatva etāneva loka dhātu paraṃparona bhilā pyānābhilāpya būddha kṣatrapara

dharaniSamgrahaSections.titleIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (22): pariṇampayadāpta puṇṣamana kamatīvaviśiṣṭaṁ| tenajagadvya sanoghati magnaṁ yātvamitābha purīvaramaca
paragraphsIast: ṣaḥ sarvabhāva svabhāva dhṛka|| anūtpāda dharma viśvārthaḥ sarvadharma svabhāva dhṛka||40|| stimitaḥ sūprasanātmā
samyakasaṃbūddha bodhidhṛka|| pratyakṣaḥ sarvabuddhānāṃjñāciṃ sūprabhāsvaraḥ||42|| pratyavekṣanā jñānagāthā
dvācatvāriṃśataḥ|| iṣṭhārtha sādhakaḥ paraḥ sarvapāya viśodhakaḥ|| sarvasatvottamā nāthaḥ sarvasatva pramocaka||1
kleśaṃ saṃgrāmaśūraka ajñāna ripūdarpahā|| dhīḥ śṛṃgāradharaḥ śrīmāna vīra vībhasta rupadhṛk||2|| bāhūdaṃḍaśatākṣepaḥ
padanikṣepanarttanaḥ|| śrīmachatrutrajuṃ jāgogāga gabhoga narttanaḥ||3
ekapāda talākrāṃta mahīmaṃḍatale sthitaḥ vrakṣyāṃḍa
śikharākrāṃta pādāṃguṣṭhanakhe sthitaḥ||4|| ekātthakhodvaya dharmāthaḥ paramāttho vineśvaraḥ| nānāvijñāpti rupārthasthita
vijñāna saṃtatiḥ ||5|| aśeṣa bhāvārtharatiḥ śunyatāratiragraṃdhīḥ|| bhavarāgādyatītaśca bhavanraya mahārati

sarvvatray dhvagatebhirjinobhiryyā parināmavarṇṇitū agrāḥ| tāya ahaṃ kūśalaṃ imū sarvā nāma yabhīvarabha dravarīye|| || kāla kriyācm ahaṃkara māṇo ācaraṇāṃnvinivarbhta yisarvvān| samukhapaṇṣiyakat amitābhaṃmecaṃ sukhāvatī kṣatravajeyaṃ|| || tatṛgat spa-īm praṇidhāna āmukhi sarvvābhave samagrāḥ| tācy ahaṃparipūrī aśeṣān| satva hitaṃkariyā vatalāke|| ||tehinamaṇūlaśaubhanarasye padamavarerucire upapannaḥ| tyākaraṇaṃ ahutatrala bheyā saṃmukhe to amitābha jinasya|| || vyākaraṇaṃ pratiramatyavā tāsminnirmmita koṭīśate bhiranekaiḥ satvāhitānicahanpaca kuryyā did-ū- daśasvapibūddhevalena|| || bhadravarī praṇidhāna paṭhitvā tkuśalaṃmayisaṃvita kictrita| eka kṣaṇe nasamṛtkṣya usarvva tenajagasyaśūbhaṃ praṇidhānaṃ|| || bhadravarrī

pariṇampayadāpta puṇṣamana kamatīvaviśiṣṭaṃ| tenajagadvya sanoghati magnaṃ yātvamitābha purīvaramaca|| || āryyabhadravarīmahāpraṇidhāna ratna rājaṃ samāptaṃ|| || oṃ namo lokathāya|| oṃ namaḥ śrī āryyā va lokiteśvarāya|| bodhisatvāyamahā satvāya mahākāruṇikāya|| evaṃmayā śṛta me kasminsamaye bhagavānāryyāvalokiteṇṣaṭasya bhagavate pāṭarake parvvata śikharayarānāratna vṛkṣasahasra samādhi vyakīrṇte jāmvanade suvarṇtukāctrenobhāsa|| nānāratnamaya vimāna bhūmipradeśa viharātisma|| anekaiśvadevanāgayakṣa suragaruḍa kinnara mahoragamatuṣyā koṭi niyūta śata sasamraiḥ sārddha tatrakhalū bhagavānū puraskṛta smaṃskṛtī gurūkṛto mānitaḥ pūjito ardhito apacāyito parivūta dharmma deśayatisma|| ādaukalyānaṃ madhaukalyānaṃ paryyavasāṇakaṃsyā

paragraphsIast: śuddhaśutrātradhavalaḥ|| śaraccaṃdraśubhamaprabhaḥ|| vālārkamaṃḍalachāyomahārāgakhaprabhaḥ||7|| iṃdranīsāgrasaddhī
romahānīlaka cāgradhṛka|| mahāmaṇimayūrāśrībudhanirmāṇabhūṣaṇaḥ||8|| lokaśātuśatākaṃpī ṛddhi pādamahākramaḥ
mahāsmṛtidharasatvaścetuḥ smṛtisamādhirāṭ||9|| vodhvaṃgakusumomoda tathāgataguṇodadhiḥ|| aṣṭāṃgamārganayavit
samyakkaṃbuddhamārgavita||10|| sarvasatvemahāyaṃgotiḥ saṃgoganopamaḥ|| sarvasattvamanoyātaḥ sarvasatyamanojavaḥ||11
sarvasatvekriyārthajñaḥ sarvasatvamanohareḥ paṃcaskandharthatatvajñaḥ paṃcaskandhaviśuddhadhṛka||12|| sarvaniryāṇakoṭiskaḥ
sarvinaryāṇadeśakaḥ||13|| dvādaśāṃgabhavebhavato dvādaśākāraśuddhadhṛka|| catuḥsatyanayākāraḥ suṣūbhatānāvavodhadhṛk
dvādaśākārasatyārthaḥ ṣoḍaśakāratatvavit

sambhavaḥ kamalāsanaḥ kamalamukhaḥ kalamahastaḥ kamaṇḍarūvyagrahastaḥ kṛṣṇājinadharaḥ tridaṣḍadharaḥ akṣadharaḥ padmadharaḥ pravitadharaḥ pūrvā bhikhiḥ amṛtavarṣaḥ cintāmaṇikalpaḥ sudarśakalpa vṛkṣaḥ sarvvasatvadhanikaraḥ sarvavyādhiprasamanaḥ tikaraḥ sarvvasatvoprajiṣyaḥ buddha nirmmāṇakāyacaḥ sugateveśadharaḥ sugatadhātudharaḥ ekaikamarokupasarvasatva saṃsāraḥ kṛtapuṇyaḥ kṛtakṛtyaḥ kṛtakaraṇīyaḥ kṛtakuśalaḥ kṛtaniścayaḥ uttaptavīryyaḥ saṃsāranikrāntaḥ saddharmmadovarādyātiṣekaḥ tārānugatacaraṇaḥ bhṛkuṭikṛtajñaḥ jayavanto nayavantāsmṛtivantaḥ mahāvikramantaḥ guṇavantaḥ maitrīyavantaḥ śīlavantaḥ dayāvantaḥ śāntavantaḥ|| smṛtivantaḥ bhāgyavantaḥ arthavantaḥ arthānāṃdātāraḥ saṃsayānācchatāraḥ dharmmānāṃpravaktāraḥ lookānāṃśāstāraḥ paripurṇugandramaṇḍalamukhaḥ sarvvaratna ṣacitānimbapraveśaḥ suvapupastayīḥ

suryyasahasrātireka tejā ruciraśarīre vraṣkendādine maskate iti|| || yaḥ kaścidāryāvalokite śvaraspanāmāṣṭotara śatenamtrotrā pahārakuryyotātaspatrca nannataryyāṇikarmmācaraṇāni parikṣayaṃ gacchati|| sarvvamāgulaṃ praviṣṭhobhavanti| sarvva mantrānita spasiddhānita| aneka kalpa koṭhiniyuta satasahasrāṇi durgatinnajārā|| avicīna praviśaṃti| tasyacamaraṇa kālasamaye sutvāvatyāṃloka dhātu dhupa yadyaṃte|| jātojātau āryyāvalokiteśaravirahito bhavanti|| samatrajāpena medhāvī bhavati|| śurāśurayaḥ savaraḥ sarvva śāsta viśārada ā deyavāṣṭo bhavati|| anenamtotrā pahāraṃ kuryyāta dvāṣaṣṭhī gargānadīyālukāsamoyu būddhā bhagavanta pujito bhavanti|| samovipākonā ṣṭi viśe| sarvvajñajina ratnadhātu karaṇukaṃnāma bhagavanta āryyālokiteśvara spa-aṣṭobhāra śatanāma mahāyāna śūtraṃ samāptaṃ||0

kāyakoṭivī tāvakaḥ|| sarvakṣaṇābhisamayaḥ sarvavilorbhuṇārthavit|| || nānāyānanapāya jagadartha vibhāvakaḥ

dharaniSamgrahaSections.titleIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (30): rvvaṇatraṁ sarvvamantrātasarvvajogānu sarvvarākṣasā dināṁ rakṣa 2 māṁmamasarvva satvānāctra savvepidravo pasaṁgo pāyāsesyaḥ svāhā
paragraphsIast: majamabuye manuṣyāsu spāyuṣo varṣaśatāyurska ṣāvaṃśunya kāsamasanāni nirdiṣṭhāni|| yāvalu maṃtru śrīyaṃsatvo aśyāya
vitā yurstathāgatasthaguṇanavarṇū parikī kathena nāma dharmaparthyāyaṃ likhiṣyānti nāma dhyeyamātra mapiśroṣya kriyāvatdhūsta
kaganāma pikṛtvāgṛhe dhāraciṣyanti parthyavākyānti parebhyaśca vistareṇa saṃprakāśayiṣyānti ācatpuṣpa dhūpa gandha
ālya visepana cūrṇa cāvara chatra dhvaja ghaṇṭhā patākā bhiśvasama kābhiśva pūjābhiḥ pūjāyiṣyānti|| te parikṣīṇā

sarpunareva varṣa śatāyuṣo bhaviṣyānti| yāvalu punaḥ maṃjuśrī satvāstatrā parimitāyujñāni su viniścita tejorājasya tathāgatasya nāmāṣṭo tasśetaṃ śroṣyānti dhāraciṣyānti vācayiṣyānti|| tevāṃmāyu vividdhī dhiṣyāntice parikṣīṇā
yuṣaḥ satvānāma dhyayaṃ śroṣyānti dhāraciṣyānti vāca dhiṣyānti teṣāṃma māyurvivardhva ciṣyānti|| tasmākarhī
maṃjuśrīya dīrghāyuṣkāṃnā prārthadhi

rvvaṇatraṃ sarvvamantrātasarvvajogānu sarvvarākṣasā dināṃ rakṣa māṃmamasarvva satvānāctra savvepidravo pasaṃgo pāyāsesyaḥ svāhā|| āryyā amritā nāma dhāraṇī samāptaṃ|| || oṃ namo ratnatrayāya|| oṃ namo buddhāya mahākāruṇikāya bharaṇikṛtahṛdayāya|| oṃ āḥ sugatavajatṛsyahoḥ svāhā|| āryya sugata nāmadhāraṇī samāptaṃ|| oṃ namo bhagavate bheṣayavaiḍuryyaprabha rājāya tathāgatāyarhate samyakasaṃbuddhāya|| tadyathā oṃ bheṣaye mahābhaiṣaṭta bhaiṣaṭate svāhā|| āryya bhaiṣayta rājanāma dhāraṇī samāptaṃ|| oṃ maṇi padme hūṃ|| oṃ namo bhagavate āryyapara maguravai mahākāruṇikāya śākya manuṣye tathāgatā yārhate samyaksaṃbuddhāya|| tadyathā|| oṃ mūne mahāmunaye svāhā|| āryya śākya muni nāmadhāraṇī samāptaṃ|| oṃ namaḥ sapta saptīnāṃsamyaksaṃbuddhā koṭīnāṃ

vitatejo rājāyatathāgatāyārhante sa myakakaṃ buddhāya|| ḍo takṣyathā| oṃ puṇya? mahāpuṇya aparimita
puṇya-aparimatāyu jñāna suviniśa-acitasaṃtārodharvita|| oṃ sarvasaskārapaviśuddhe dharmmate gamaṇe samu ḍaga lekhabhāva

rimitāyusutrabhāṣitaṃ|| oṃ namo bhagavate aparimitāyurjñāna suviniścitatejo rājāyasnathāgatāthahinte samyakka buddhāya
tadyathā

buddha dharmma saṃgha satyana mābhṛkarmma satyena satyavādi satyena|| mābhṛkarmmaṇa lambodalī| kūṭa kūṭāpa rudramānaya| viṣṇumānya candra sūryya mānaya| trailokvādhiṣṭhita mānaya| sarvva yakṣa rākṣasa kumbhāṇu mahāragādi mānaya| māṃrakṣa rakṣāpaya cūrū puṣmapālinī| rundha jhaṇa tili citi bhṛkuṭi mukhi|| parasenya kulo chādanakari| hara hiri haru dhvaṃdha| he rinamiti| jambū dhvaja vilo kiterakṣa māṃsarvva satvānā dhasarvva tathāgatā valokite svāhā|| oṃ guṇarājo prabhāsotta māpa svāhā|| oṃ sarvva nakṣatra granakṣatra dhyātmikaraṇe svāhā|| oṃ rakṣa māṃsarvva bhayetyaḥ svāhā|| sarvva satvā notrca sarvva bhayetyaḥ svāhā|| mahāpasode vendro dhvajāgrakepūra nāma dhāraṇī aparājitāntarakvacitu jage atikalyena vātigrahetyaḥ vivādetyaḥ sarvva bhayobhaviṣyanti|| dhvajāgrakathātāṃ

tato dhārayita vyāmānūṣpasyā rāja cūḍakaṇṭhecā likhikṛta dhārayetū sarvva michākaroti mtrīrupātra dhāraye yurājāvā atirakṣā karoti|| parasainpadya yeti prāpta kā śrīlakṣīnā mutrcati pāpakāḥ|| idamavocadbhagavānāttamanāsteca śakrādidevābhi kṣavo bodhisatvā mahāsatvā sāva sarvvāca tīparṣatsadevaḥ mānuṣā suragaruḍa gandharvvaśca loko bhagavato bhāṣita matyanandanniti| āryya dhvajā grakeyaranāma dhāraṇī samāptaṃ|| oṃ namaḥ śrī mahāsamvarāya|| pūrvvavataḍhatiṭhi śūnya tānantaraṃ hūṃ kāroṭbha vaṃ yogiṇī gaṇanākaṃ| bhairavaṃ kāli rātrīnatrca karttikā sūryyā gaupati ritāṇu vaṇna mahākāyaṃ kṛṣṇārddhaha ritārddha kaṃpaṣṭati jujāstasya saptadaśa trirocana jaṭā mekuṭa dharaṃvīraṃ viśvavajārddha candrakaṃ| mahādraṣṭrā kallāro śāṃsa vyāvasaḥ sadā|| nīlāpītāra

suviniścita tejorājāyastayāgatā yārhake samyakka buddhāya? || tadyathā|| oṃ puṇyaḥ mahāpuṇya aparimita puṇya

trcamaghavṛkṣākuśastathā| evaṃ kramato viṣṇayādvāsaptita rāṣṭakāpatrcamudrākṛtā bharaṇaṃ dhanāja paṃta bharaṇaṃ|| śatamuṇḍa mālikā cevatayula nāma ragavyā pracarmmā nivasanā romāvalī cagrāntamā|| tasyā tratomahāvevīvaja vārāhītā dṛśāḥ dvi jujāṃ savyakarbhtitrcavāmaka pārakuṃthā rāvajadhaṣṭhā tyāṃ bhagavatyā liṃgā mahārāgāana rāminī eka vaktamuktakregā trcanāmomturakta varṇḍikā|| muṇumālāśitā grīvāṇaṃmmaraṇā jvalāśila sikaparasālāca divyagandhā mūlāginī to pūrakarpurā diṣudivya śamnāsabhūṣiṇī|| ṣadānvābharaṇey ratnābharaṇa trinetra jāpalyā disamayādiptimahātejaparameśvarī|| prajñāpāya sukhādatrca saṃdhiṣa vigrahā he rukajvalendavispharantaṃ vibhāvayeta|| evaṃ rupatu mahāvajaherukaṇna vibhāvayat|| sarvva satvā samāyūktaṃ mokṣa siddhiṃca dehime|| tatokāya mantuḥ|| oṃ āḥ kāyavākcitta

vaja hūṃ phaṭ|| oṃ vaja vārāhī mahādevī hūṃ phaṭ|| mūlamantraḥ|| iti mahāsatvara hṛdayaṃ samāptaṃ|| || oṃ namaḥ śrī cakamahāroṣanāya|| śrī matsyakta ravinvāya sarvvasattva pakāriṇi namo vighnoya saṃhāraṃ kāya triyaka muktayaṃkaraṇe deva khaṅāya sarvvanāpāya bhāvayene vāme prajñārga bhāṇyena tarjaṇi śaktapāśe| saptapātāra pārākṣamadhya vāmāya darśine śakravraṣkyaṇupāratvātnamaḥ savyerddha darśine bhūmautaktakṣaṇa tvātrya vineṣṭā vāmajānave| mahāprahāra saṃskārana savyapādāyate namaḥ|| magnaṃyena kṣacca rāva ramidaṃ mahāndhakāro dyaḥ|| prajñāpāya vibhāga bhāskara varairvyaktaṃ samūdvīpitaṃ kṛtvā candra samādyamādya puruṣaḥ śrī vajasatvasvayaṃ|| soyaṃ tatsūkha sādhanāya jagativyakta prabhātiṣṭhātti|| tatomantragāthāḥ|| viśvāmbhoja dineśa maṇu lagataṃ hūṃ kāra vīyodbhavaṃ dṣṭābhiḥ para pīḍītādharamala dhārāṣṭra haṃsaparāḥ|| urdhyā māsā

paragraphsIast: puṇya aparimitāya puṇya jñāna saṃbhāro pacite|| oṃ sarvasa kārapariśuddha dharmmate gagaṇasamudra tesvabhāva viśuddhe
mahānayaparivāre svāhā||6|| tenakhalu punaḥ samayena paṃca vāśatīnā buddhākoṭināmeṃ kamatenaika svarena iṃdamaparimitāyu
sutraṃ bhāvitaṃ|| oṃ namo bhagavate aparamitāyu jñāna suviniścita tejo rājāya tathāgatā yārhake samyukkaṃ buddhāyaṃ
tadyathā|| oṃ puṇya mahāpuṇya aparamita puṇya aparimitāyu puṇyajñāna saṃbhāro pacite|| oṃ sarvasaskāra pariśuddha

buddhakoṭināṃkamateneka svarena idaṃ aparimināyu sutraṃ bhāṣitaṃ|| oṃ namo bhagavate aparimitāyu jñāna suviniścita tejo
rājā yastathāgatā yārhake samyakubuddhāya|| tadyathā|| oṃ puṇya mahāpuṇya aparimita puṇya aparimitāyu puṇya jñāna sambhāro pite||oṃ

virājita dakṣiṇa kare pāśārkuśaṇyātala vande śrīvalacavu mahāroṣaṇa kroḍhamūdāhaṃsadā|| oṃ namaḥ śrī caṇu mahāroṣaṇvaya|| oṃ hīṃ hīṃ caṇurupyecaṭa pracaṭa kaha prasphūraya praskārāya hana graha vandhaya jambhaya jambhaya mohya sarvva śatrūṇāṃ mūkha vandhanaṃkuru sarvvaḍākinīnāṃ grahabhūta piśāśca vyāghrayakṣaṇīsaṃ trāśaya mara māraya ru ru ru ka candra mahāroṣaṇa mājñāpayati|| oṃ oṃ oṃ candra mahāroṣaṇe hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭa phaṭa svāhā|| oṃ caṇu mahāroṣaṇa dya dya dyāṭa sarvvadūṣṭāyendrāsa parivārāna kīlaya hūṃ phaṭ|| yathevayama varuṇa kūbera anarānarākṣasane anīlāna iśānyāṣan| uddha vrakśā-ādo pṛthvī nyāna| evaṃ kīla nākophṭa nābhyāṃ niviprata bhāvayet|| caṇeśvarāni rātrā sāṃkṛtya pūnarvajasatvātmako bhūtvā vāgavādidhātuna bhāvayet|| oṃ cāmṇḍe' jite parājite krūṃ krūṃ krūṃ rakṣa svāhā|| iti caṇuma

hā roṣaṇa samādhi hṛdaya samāptaṃ|| oṃ namaḥ śrī harukāya|| oṃ kroḍhapirgelakeśāya sahamratekṣasyadhara jvāla prajvāla triśūla vyagrahate hara prasara dama gṛntpāpaya sarvva dūṣṭa satvānāṃ nāgānāgarājā nāṃ mūkhaṃ kīlaya śulaṃnośa piṃhanāśaya aśmarāṇāśaya evaṃ sarvva nāśānāṃ nāśaya ekāhikaṃ dayāhikaṃ bhyāhikaṃ cāturthihikaṃ sarvvajvalaṃ sannipātajvalaṃ dūṣṭa jvalaṃ vātikaṃ pittikaṃ śreṣṭikaṃ sannipātikaṃ māsā-ī māsikaṃ sāmvatsarikaṃ evaṃ evaṃ sarva rogāna nāśaya hūṃ śrī akṣotya vajarupamama sarvvasatvā nātrca śānti kūra svāhā|| āryya śrī heru kaspaprasavaroganāmadhāraṇī samāptaṃ|| oṃ namo bhagavatyai āryyavajavārārṣke|| tadyathā|| oṃ namā bhagavati vajavārā hi āryya parājite trailokya mātre mahāvaidye sarvvabhūta yāvaha mahāvaja vajāmane ajite parājite vaśāṃkarane

paragraphsIast: kṣita tejo rājāyasa tathāgatāyārha kre samyakasaṃbuddhāya|| tadyatā|| oṃ pūṇya mahāpūṇya aparimita pūṇya aparimitāyū
pūṇya jñāna saṃbhāro pacite|| oṃ sarva saskāra pariśuddha dharma te gagaṇa samūdra te svabhāva viśūddha mahānaya parivāre svāhā
yasmi pṛthvi pradeśva idaṃ ma parimitoyūḥ sūtraṃ likhiṣyaṃti ti likhā payiṣyaṃ ti sa pṛthivī pradaśercaya bhūto
vaṃdanīya śva bhaviṣyaṃti tirdhagyo nigatānāṃ mṛga pakṣi dakṣiṇo kūjña pūre nipakti ṣyati gate sarva arurāyāṃ samyakkaṃ bodhisati
saṃbholyante|| oṃ namo bhagavate aparimitāyū jñāna sūviniścita tejo rājāyasa tathāgatā yārhante samyakasambuddha-āya
tadyathā|| oṃ pūṇyaśgamahāpūṇya aparimitapūṇya aparimitāyū pūṇya jñāna saṃbhārā pacite oṃ sarvasaskāra pariśuddha dharmma te
gagaṇa samudra te svabhāva viśuddha mahānaya parivāre svāhā|| || idaṃ ma parimitāyūḥ sutraṃ likhi

tvayā| lakṣālakṣaṇavinirmuko vāgravādā hāravarjitaṃ|| śāntāśānta jaga ddṛṣṭhaṃ bhagavatā jñānacakṣaṣā| nasamutyadayate bhāvanāpāhaṃ sadasannibhaḥ|| ne sve tonāpi paratonadatyāṃ jāyate kathaṃ| bhāvanāthāntaraṃnā śāppanarthānta raṃmataṃ|| ethāntara bhaventivyanāpi nāppānathantaret|| ekatvehi prabhāvasya vināsamuṣa padyate| pṛthakcetanehi bhavasyavināśa mupapadayate|| vinaṣṭho kāraṇo ttāvatkāryyotyatti na yutryate| navāvi naṣṭhatmadayena tralyotpattirmmatāntava|| vi buddhāvdāmo buddhādvāvījādaṃ kulasambhavaḥ|| māyopādo vahutpādaḥ sarvamevatva yotryate|| atastyathā jagadidaṃ parikalpa sumudbhav|| parijñate samabhutaṃ anutpannānupathyati| nitya saṃmṛti saṃsmṛti proktātva tatva vidāmbaraḥ|| svapnaiva saṃsmṛti proktātva tatva vidāmbaraḥ| svayaṃkṛta pakṛśaddhātyāṃkṛta mahetrukaṃ|| tānkiṃkariṣyateduḥ khaṃtvayātruktaṃ parityajet| yaḥ

pratityasamutpādaḥ śunyetā mevate sadā|| bhāvaḥ svatantronāstiti siṃhanādaṣṭa cātrare| sarvvasaṃkalpa hārāya śunyatā mṛtadeśanā|| yasyatasyā mapigrāhastvayā' sauvacasāhitaḥ| ninīśavasikāsinyā māyāvatpja-eya yodbhavāḥ|| sarvvadharmmastvayā nāthaniḥ svabhāvaḥ prakāśitā natvayātpatitaṃ kitaṃ kicintakitrcintira rodhitaṃ|| yathā pūrvvatathā paścāttatathā buddhavānasi| aryyaniṣecitā dharmma manāgasyahi bhāvanā| nimittānihi vijñānaṃ bhavatīha kathaṃcana| aninittāṃhi vijñānaṃ bhavatīha kathaṃcana| animitta manāgamya mokṣonāstitva muktavāna| atastvayā mahāyānatasmākalpena deśitaṃ|| yadavāvtaṃ mayaṃpuṇyaṃmutvā tvāṃmutibhājanaṃ| nimityevaṃdhanāyete bhuyānte nākhilaṃ jagat|| itiśrī lokātīta stavanāmastotraṃ samāptaṃ|| || oṃ namaḥ śrī vajayogiśye|| evammayā śṛtamekasminsamayekṣa

tena trisāham mahāsāham lokadhā-usakaratra mayaṃ pariṣūjña katvā dānaṃ dayostasya pūṇya skandhasya pramoṇagaśathi unatvaṃma

nā bhaya samākule ||47|| smaraśā devanāmāni sarvabhayānya pohati|| nā kāla mṛtyū bhavati pronyoti vipulaṃ yaśaḥ||48|| mānu ṣya saphalaṃ janma tasyai kasya mahātmanaḥ|| yastvi daṃprātarutyāya mānavaḥ kīrtta yiṣyati||49|| sadīrgha kāla māyuṣmāna śriyaṃca labhate nayaḥ|| vallabhaḥ sarvasatvānāṃsarvasatva hitaṃ karaḥ|| || devā nāgāstathā yakṣā gaṃdharva kaṭaputanāḥ|| piśācārākṣasābhūtā mā taśe rodrate jasaḥ|| || ḍākinyāstārakāḥ pretāḥ skaṃdonmādā mahāgrahāḥ|| chāyā pasmā rasāścaivayeckākhordakādyaḥ|| || vetālāścivvakāḥ preṣyāyecānye duṣṭa cetasaḥ|| chāyāmapi nalaṃ dhāṃtikaṃ punasta sthavigrahaṃ|| || duṣṭasatvānavādhaṃte vyādhayonā kramaṃtita|| sarveśvarya gurṇeryuktā putrapautraśca baddhate|| || jātismarobhaveddhimāna kulīnmaḥ priyadarśanaḥ|| prītimātrcamahāvāgmī

gabhahatalastha svachaṃdraścandra rudra prabhati nara maruta siddhi gandharghanā gāṃdiśca krākrāmidhā maskita sūgata sūtāna nandanirmāṇa vikraṃvitraṃtelokavaśca sthiravara canavitāśoṣayāva svabhāvaṃ|| lākṣā siṃdūra gāruṇa tara kiraṇāditya lohitya mekeśrīmatsāndranda nīlotpala dala dalita kro dalaṃ tathānoḥ|| kṣīlodhikṣaśca dūgdhādhika tara dhavalaṃ kāśca nā bhaśca kecistva drū paṃviśca rūpaṃ skuṭika va dūpa dhā yūtkitedā dhi bhinnaṃ|| sarvajña jñānadvipa prakaṭita sakalajña ya gatveka sākṣī sākṣā dvekritva dī yāṃguṣyagaṇagagaṇāsarva cibhrasūtovā yanruvyādāya vaktuṃ vali trjuja rahitaṃ māhaśorā rahīti vyopatsātī vradṛṣṭava dvārajanitarujaśveta sohasyahenuḥ|| yatme vijñakyū mānaṃ prathamataramada stvaṃ viśeṣaṃṇa vestthita tvyāhārā tire ka śrama vidhira buddhaṃ svāntasaṃ toṣadrenuḥ|| kiṃ nu snigdha sya vandhyorviṣamivapūrato dūṣṭava mūdrīryyavāca

jñānārtha syāvidaḥ svīhṛdayala dhūta yā svacchatāṃvindatīca|| kalyāṇānda siṃdhū prakaṭaśaśikaleśrī bharāṃde driṣṭaṣṭi pūṣṭijñānāya deśekurudhana karuṇaścaṃ sayaścātaṃ maktaḥ| ttvanstotrāṃbhaḥ pavitrīkṛtamanasimathiśreya saṃskāramekaṃ dṛṣṭuṃ yasmāda modhaṃjagati tavaguṇatramātraṃ prajānāṃ|| maṃsulatvaṅjugu ṇodhāvayavamaniyame yatra māptaṃ mayāyatpūṇyaṃ pūṇyādrevāṃchā phala madhura rasāsvāda bhābhakti bhogyam| lokastanāryya lokeśca svaraṇagarasva stikaṃsyāsmi ciṃkrāma krāyāyaṃ prayāyātsūgata sutamahītāstvā varyāpāsyome|| inyāryyantarā bhaṭṭā rikāyāḥ śragdharāskāśraṃ samāptaṃ|| || oṃ namaḥ śrī āryya ugra tārā yo ekajaṭāyai|| namaḥ śrāvakapraścaka yūśca bodhisatva krorarajāyūśca dharmmasaṃghasyaḥ| namo bhagavate parama gurave mahākāruṇi kāyaśākka mūnaye tathāgato yorhame sampakkaṃ būddhāya|| evaṃ

paragraphsIast: śakkaṃ gaṇari-uṃ|| oṃ namo bhagavate aparimitāyū jñāna suviniścita tejo rājāyasa tathāgatāya arhante samyaka
sambuddhāya|| tadyathā|| oṃ puṇya mahāpuṇya aparimitapūṇya aparimitāyū pūṇya jñāna saṃbhāro pacite|| oṃ sarva
saskāra pariśuddha dharma te gagaṇa samūdra te svabhāva va viśuddha mahānāya parivāre svāhā||24|| yathā sūmerū parvata rājasya
sakarat rāśī kṛtvā dānaṃ dū tasya pūṇya skandhasya pramāṇa śaṣkaṃgaṇa yi u|| tatvaṃ parimitāyūḥ sūtraṃ tasya pūṇya skandha
sya pramāṇaṃ śakkaṃ gaṇāyi-ū|| yathā vatvāro mahā samūdra udaka paripūrjña bhaveyū ekaika vindū gaṇayi-u|| na tvaṃ parimitāyūḥ

samyaksaṃbuddhāya|| tadyathā|| oṃ pūṇya mahāpūṇya aparimitapūṇya aparimitāyū pūṇya jñāna saṃbhārā pacite|| oṃ sarva saskāra pariśuddha

monamaḥ|| yaśce tāṃdhāraye dviyāṃkaṇṭhe vākūca mastake| nityaṃranti devāstaṃdaityā nāgāścamānūṣāḥ|| gandharvvāḥ kinnarāyakṣābhūtapreta piśācagā|| ḍākinyorākṣasādūbhyaḥ kūmbhāṇḍāḥ kaṭapūṭanāḥ| trisaṃdhyāyaḥ paṭhenna tyaṃ būddhā rakṣāntitaṃ sadā| vajapāṇiśca yakṣendrośakraśca tridaśaiḥ sahaḥ| catvāraśca mahārājāvrakṣatyā viṣkaṃmaheśvarāḥ| bhairavaṃmātṛkā durgā stathānye mārakāyikāḥ|| vidyādevyāmahāvīryyāmahābalaparākramāḥ| māmakī bhṛkūṭī tārā sūbīryyo mṛtakūṇḍarī| vajā parājitāca caṇḍī svarṇṇakeśīca pirgalā| ekajaṭā mahādaivī dhanyā viyūtsūmālinī|| śrīsarasvatī lakṣmī siddheśvarī sadānūgāḥ|| tame vānye dirakṣānti yasya vidyākare sthitāḥ| sabhavetsarvva sātvānāṃ mokṣaṇārtha samṛdayataḥ|| rājāno vaśagā stasya pūṇyarāśi vibaddha yeta|| siddhayante sarvva karmmāṇi pratiṣṭhā jimamaṇḍile| ante bauddhapadaṃ yā yājjiḥ

nyasavacanaṃyathā|| yāntrīdhārayake vidyāprasūyaṅuṇī sukhaṃ| apūtrī labhatepūtraṃvyādhi mūkto sukhāśiṇī|| dhanadhānyaiṃ valaiḥ pūṇyāmo nanīyā priyaṃvadā| sūsva prāsavya karī vajiṇakṣataṃ samāpnayātū|| oṃ āḥ rima ha haḥ|| idamavocadbhavagavānsāya padmamālagiriyarṣa tsadeva mānūṣā suraga ruḍa gandharvva ścalākobhagavato bhāṣita matyanandanniti|| āryyā eka jaṭā nāmadhāraṇī samāptaṃ|| oṃ namaḥ śrīdharmma dhātave|| natvārktavandhū jūgade kavandhū svayaṃ tubhadrārakamādidevaṃ| jarā-ūjā mṛtyūharai kadakṣaṃkṣyetadddeśamahaṃ samastaṃ|| nepālejagati khyāte gośṛ gonāma parvdataḥ bhedosticaja getassa nāstrācajagabhedakaḥ|| yūgyesatyapanāgirimtetā thāṃvaja kūṭakaḥ| gośṛṅovāpare khyātāḥ kaligopūcha parvataḥ|| gartekālabhaviṣya cavarnta māne pravartate|| itiddeśavāśī

paragraphsIast: dharma te gagana samūdrate svabhāva viśuddha mahānaya parivāre svāhā|| || yaḥ idaṃ ma parimitāyūḥ sūtraṃ likhiṣyati
likhāpayiṣyaṃti satkṛtya pūjayiṣyaṃti|| te radaśa diśi sarvadikṛ sarva buddha kṣe kṣetreśū sarva tathāgata vanditā pūṇitā śva
bhaviṣyati|| oṃ namo bhagavate aparimitāyū jñāna suviniścita tejo rajāyasa tathāgatāya arhanta samyakamabuddhāya
tadyāthā|| oṃ pūṇya mahāpūṇya aparimitapūṇya aparimitāyū pūṇya hānaṃ saṃbhārāyacitte|| oṃ sarva saskāra pariśuddha dharma
te gagaṇa samūdra ta svabhāva viśuddha mahānaya parivāre svāhā|| || dānavare na samūdra ta būddhā dāna vasādhigatānana siṃhā
dānavase syaca śuyaniṇaṇda kāruṇyakaḥ sya pūre praviśattaṃ|| śālavane na sūdrata buddhā śālevalādhigatāna siṃhā
śālevalesya ca suyatti śabda kā dū śvabhaḥ sya pūre praviśanta|| śaktivajñe na samūdra na buddhā krāti vasādhiga

raṇanataraḥ dvaṣṭaḥ saṃpṛktya saṃkalānācāryyenasya sādaraḥ tadanti kātsava bhava naṃgatvā cāryyam sāsayat|| evaṃ maitreyane bāle devasthāna syasiśdabhūḥ| mahanprabhāvaca tatrasevyate mokṣa kāmabhiḥ sarvvaśānti karodeva ācāryyasva mahārddhikaḥ evaṃ kṛtyaṃ samāvṛtya samādhitvidadheparāṃ|| svapūrābhyāgrato'dhastāgatbhāya| jana mānataḥ| dharmmātmakasya kalyāṇaśrī sūkhaṃ vivalaṃta|| tartbhū svargāpamākalpa vṛkṣa citta sūmaṇḍitā|| manora māsti tatrebhya samādhikūta niścayaḥ|| samādheḥ samamūtthayacira kāle nakādṛka deśapiḍhyatine pāle dharmma mokṣa prakāśakaṃ|| idaṃ śṛṇūmaitreya paścātkārāntaraṃtataḥ | iyaṃya| bhikṣuṇīcūtrāsūśīlāśīla dhāriṇī| pravatryāṃ vidadhe dharmma dhātuvāgīśvaraścasā| maṃjūśrī khikhasyā syaigṛhya prakṣālyavotparāta|| ocalecalecūrḍe svāhe timantreṇa japyaṇāsamālā kilāṇū ditaṃ tatve bhakto pajūñjate te asthāpasthānacaryyāya vaśabhyadaya pisāvratī

asyepūṇya prabhāvena caibhyodvādaśavatsare|| pañcāmijñā bhilāsīsā bhaviṣyatina saṃśayaḥ|| ityvāca jaga śreṣṭhośākya siṃhojagadguruḥ|| śrutetikāśya pavarābhikṣavo lodhimārgmagāḥ| maitreya pramukhā devā nāgalo kā sūrāḍhyaḥ|| sāca sarvvāvatīparṣadanū godanta-ityalaṃ| idaṃ sūraṃ khalū mānavāṇāṃ sūbūddhā vādyātū vimokṣa mārggaṃ||śṛśrotivāśrākyate maṇūṣyaḥ sayātrinūjaṃ sūgatasya lokaṃ api khalū lokāvāgma tīnāṃ prabhāvanaviditta catākāraciḍhyānti satyaṃ|| taḍhanūsakalamātma sokhyaṃ catuktyā sūgatavara rājyaṃ tuṇūnaṃ prayānti|| itiśrī svayatthūḥ pūrāṇe caitya bhaṭarakoddeśa mahaprabhāvarṇṇano namo-uṣṭhamaḥ paricheda samāptaṃ|| || oṃ namo bhagavatye āryyaśrī vasūdhārāyai|| vasūdhārāṃ sadānatvā dāridrāṇaktāreṇī deśayāgi manūḍhyārthaṃ sarvvadaḥ khapramocanī|| pūrvvaṃ śrī vasūdhārādevī vratasūtraṃ prakāśitaḥ|| kathā pravankāmikṣū yaṃtātāvata

paragraphsIast: gatanalasiṃhṛkṣāntipalesāpaśruyanti śabda kārunikaḥ spavūra pravigantaṃ|| vīryavalene samaṅgatabuddho vīryya
velādhigatānasasiṃha vīryyavastesya vaśruyanti| śabda kārunikaḥ sya surapraviśanta|| dhyānavale na samaṅgata buddho

dhyānavalādhigatā narasiṃhā dhyānavale sāva śruyanti śabdakāruṇikaḥ sva pūle praviśantaṃ|| prajñāvalenaṃ samaṅgata buddho prajñā va dhigatānarasiṃhā prajñāvalesyava śruyanti śabda kāruṇikaḥ syapure praviśaṃta|| oṃ namo bhagavan aparimitāyuñjāna
sūviniścita tejorājāya tathāgatā yārhake samākaṃ buddhāya|| tadyathā oṃ pūṇāt mahāpuṇya aparimita pūṇā
aparimitāy-pūṇāhmana saṃbhāro pacita|| oṃ sarva saṃskāra pariśuddha dharmma tegagaṇaṃsamaṅgate svabhāgava viśuddha mahānaya
paripāresvāhā| itamavoca hagavānnātmanāstecabhikṣuca steca bodhisatvāḥ sāvasarvāvatīparṣa devamānū sūragaruḍagandhaśca
lokotabhavato bhāṣita bhatyanandanniti|| āryā aparimitānāma dhāraṇī mahānaya sūtraṃ samāptaḥ

vati || sarvvaṃśṛtvā śrīvasudhārādevī trīpadakṣiṇīkṛtya pādauśira sāvānditvā cūḍadevīsvadeśepratyāgataḥ || tadācaḍadevivijñāpayati || tavaśūcīmūkhovajapāpina kathitvā' āgatāsarvvapāpina mūktikṛtvā cūḍadevī svadeśa māgatā || nagarasamīpaṃprāptavāna rājā śruyate || cūḍadevīmāgata iti || rājovāca || bhavatu ityūtvāājñāpitaḥ || amātyamahotsarvvena cūḍadevī rājagṛhemonayaḥ || amātyavoca || yathājñāpayadeva mamātyaprabhṛti sarva paurajanaṃ gatvā mahātsavainacūḍadevī rājagṛhamānayarājagṛhaṃ prāptaḥ || mahādevyārājñāpādakamalaṃ śirasā namaskāraṃkṛtvākūśala saṃvādaṃkaroti || pūnarapivo cārāyiṃkṛtaṃ || rājovāca || kathaṃbijogaṃjāyatakūtragataḥ || cūḍadevyūvāca || sarvvavṛṣattāntakathitaṃ śrīvasudhārādevī prasādā'gatohaṃnātha prabhāvena ityākarṇārājā āpāthamānībhūtvā ullāsitakathitavanta sarvadevyā sūkhena preśyāmāsa || tatovratavaṃ

ndhāpinā samāgata || cūḍedeviārājāvijñāpitaṃ pūṇya puṣpadūpanaividyādisarvopakaraṇa sajjakṛtavān || tadāsūnakṣatra śrebhādrapadakṛṣṇatṛtīyādivase sarvvaṃvratamārādhayā bhītyuktvā vrate karmācarit || tadāśrīvasudhārā svayamāgatā sarvasattvasvarggamokṣa parāyanaṃdvati || cūḍadevyāvacanaṃ śṛtvā rājapinsarvvajanā sambhāṣyavrata bandhanaṃkaroti || tasminjaṇe muhūrttamātreṇa śrivasudhārāsvathamāgatyavansakiṃvilaṃbita mitiyathāmayādeśitathā kariṣyadhvaṃ || tatorādiśrī vasūdhārāṃ dṛṣṭava rājā utphūlla hṛdayaṃbhūtvāsasaṃtramenaśrī vasūdhārāyopādakamalaṃśirasāsaṃpṛktā uktavāna || yathādevī prasanno bhūtvā tathākariṣyati vratasaṃpūrṇakṛtvā rājāprabhṛti sarvvasatvāstu ṣitatuvanaṃnīyate || rājapūtrameṃkaṃjauca rājaṃsaṃ pūrṇṇa svāpayitvā dharmmadeśanāryaṃtejanauvanena sarvvamāryamaṇḍale prakāśayitvā sūkhenatiṣṭhati || itiśrī vasudhārāvratapūrvvamartyamaṇḍalāgata kathā samāptaṃ
paragraphsDevanagari: ॥९॥ भगवतज्ञान सत्वस्य् ज्ञान मूर्तः स्वयं भुवः॥ १०॥ गंभीराथा मूदारार्था महार्थाम समांशिवा॥ आदि

yedharmātyādi|| samvat siṣitaṃ śrīdhīrja narasiṃha naṃ śrī bhājam cāyāta poyādiyā|| kvāhāsayājuro

jāhemavarṇaprabhākarī | cintāmaṇi dharā devī prajāpuṣṭaka dhāraṇī || nidhānakūṭa māruṭā (ḍhā?) dhānyā bhāradhana priyā || traidhātuka mahāāyā divyā bharaṇabhūṣitā | mātarī sarva būddhānāṃ ratnadhajñātveśvareśvarī | śūntā bhāvinī devī bhāvobhāva virjiṇī || vaineyikā vinetā cadīcinī kleśacchedinī | bhindinī sarvamorāṭhāṃ saptapātalakṣobhiṇī || drāhyāṇī vedamātā ca guhyātaguhyanivāsini | sarasvatī viśālākṣī caturbrahmavihāriṇī || tathāgati mahāramya vajīṇī vajadhāriṇī | karmadhātveśvarī vidyāviśvajvālābhamaṇḍalī || bodhīnī sarvasatvānāṃ bodhyaṃgakṛtaśeṣanī | dhānyādimūkta | saṃpanno advayādvayabhāṣiṇī || sarvārtha sādhanī bhadrāntrī rupojita vikramo | darśinī bodhīmārggānāṃ | naṣṭamārgapradeśinī || vāgīśvarī mahāśānti goptitrīdhanaddā | ntrīrupadhāriṇī siddhā yogīnīyoga īśvarī | manoharī mahākānti sau

bhāyapriyadarśiṇī | sārthavāhakṛpādṛṣṭi sarvathāgatātmakī | caturdānaṃ pradāsyāmi caturvrantra vihāriṇī || caturādya satyadeva ṛddhisiddhīpradāyinī | namaste tu mahādevī sarvasatvārthadāyinī | namostute divyarupī ca vasudhāre namostute || aṣṭhotta (bhū) raśataṃ nāma trikālaṃ yaḥ paṭhadimaṃ || prāpnoti niyataṃ siddhīmīpsitaṃ sunoharaṃ || pīdjñānāt kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ ānaṃtaryyudāruṇāṃ || tatsarvaṃ kṣepayiṣyanti smaraṇāt nāma bhadrakaṃ || atharā śīlasaṃpannaḥ sajāti smaraṇo bhavet || priyañcodaya vākyurapavān priyadarśaṇaḥ || kṣātriyaviprakuloṣu ādyamupajāyate | ante bhūmīśaraṃ prāpya saṃprayāt sukhovatāṃ || || iti śrīvasudārāyā nāmoṣśettaraśataṃ buddhabhāṣitaṃ samāptam || || om namo bhagavatyai āryaśrīvajavidārityai || namo ratnatrayo(yā) yā || evaṃ mayā śrutamekasmin samaye bhagavān vajaṣu viharati sma || sarvaśarīraṃ vajamayamadhiṣṭhāya vajrakoṭa
paragraphsDevanagari: मध्याते कत्पाशी नाम संगीति मुत्तमो॥११॥ याती तै र्भाषितो बुद्धै भीषिष्पते वक्र नागतैः॥ प्रत्यूत्पनैश्च संबूद्धैर्या

dharaniSamgrahaSections.titleIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (47): prasanna citta sūmanoḥ śucivastrairalaṁkṛtaḥ
paragraphsIast: maye svakāt vihārāta nikramāyena tathāgata vihāra stonaupasaṃkrāme dūpa makramya bahirdvā vihāra sthito bhūt
tathāgatasya darśanāya paryyupāsanāya|| athā yuṣmāna api śārabdatī pūtraḥ skādvi hārāta niṣkramya yena tatha-āgata
vihārastonaupa saṃkrānto bhagavato darśanāya vandanāya paryyapāsa nāya|| āyuṣmāna api mahāmauha'gatyāyaṇaḥ
āyuṣyamāna api mahākāśyapaḥ| āyuṣyamāna mahākauṣṭhilū|| sarvavratevānya ca mahāśrāvakā|| svakasvakestoya
vihāre tyāniṣkramāyena bhagavato vihāra stonnopa saṃkrānto upasaṃkramye krānti taskaḥ|| atha khalu bhagavāna abhikrāntā
bhikrānta mahāśrāvaka sānnipāta viditvā s vakāta vihārāt niṣkramya bahiḥ dvāvihāra syaikānate|| prajñāpte eva āsane
nyaṣīdatt| niṣaya ca bhagavāna jānan na va yuṣmāka śāradvatī pūtrama āmanprayate sma|| kṛta stvaṃśā

mahāvelavajāṃkuśa vjālāya svāhā || namo ratna trayāya || namacandravaja pāṇaye || mahāyakṣasenāpata yanamaḥ || om hara vajametha vajadhara vajahara vajapara vajadhara vajadhāraya vajadāruṇa vajacchinda vajabhinda vajahūṃ pha da || om namaścaṇuvajapāṭhāye mahākrodhāya || om phū ru tiṣṭha vandha hana dadadva amṛte hūṃ phū da || hṛdayo pahṛyaṃ mūlamantraṃ || sarvva pāpakṣayaṃ kṛtvā sarvvadūḥ yvavināśanaṃ manobhiḥ sarva mantrāṇāṃ sarvvaśrī samalaṃkṛtaḥ || upaśāntendriyobhūtvāna ṣṭhāśraya hatāyūṣaḥ | lakṣīrapivinastācare vateśca purāḍha mūkhāḥ || kāntāpriyejane dūṣṭhāḥ kūdravaśca upadratāḥ || nāsvayaṃca samarthānāṃ bhūyo vyasanamekve || grahanakṣatrapīḍāvā kākhārdda dāruṇa grahāḥ | pāpakaṃpaśya tesvanpeśokīyoga samūrcchitaṃ | tecasūsnāta śucināśrotaṃ vsūṃtramūttamaṃ || śṛṇvanume idaṃ sūtraṃ gambhīraṃ buddhaṃ gocaraṃ

prasanna citta sūmanoḥ śucivastrairalaṃkṛtaḥ || teca sarvva priduṣṭātmā upasargga sudāraḥ nanejānsidapraśānyente samastāḥ sarvvamonphatāṃā yuścavardvate puṇyaṃ sarvvapāpaurvimocitaṭha || maṇi sarṣapadūrvābhiḥ ratnākṣala saṃvandarneḥ | vajūbhāchīna puṣpaiśca jalabhā yūrjjakāñcanaṃ || ghaṭaṃturajataṃ vāpiśu vivestuṇavāsitaṃ || eka viṃśativā raṃvāvālamaṣṭhāttaraśataṃ || jayaṃdvaja vidāraṇaṃ mantraṃsnādhāyatpārthivaḥ sadā || evaṃpaśyahi dinātne satata sapadayateśubhaṃ || || ita mavocad bhagavāna vajapāṇirbhāṣita matyāntunniti || iti āryyaśrīvajacidāriṇī hṛdaya mūlamaṃtra dhāraṇī samāpta || || om namo bhagavatyai āryyagavaṇāti hṛdayāyai || sumukhaścai vadantaśya kapirogaja karṇukaṃ likhādaṃsalaścaṇikato ghna rājovināyakaḥ || dhamake karṇaṇādhikṣā bhāracandro gajānana śrī vakratuṇḍaḥ kla varṇṇā helambaskaṃndapūrvva
paragraphsDevanagari: भाषते पूनः पूनः॥१२॥ मायाजाले महातंत्रे यावस्मिनां प्रगीयते॥ महावज धरै द्वष्टै रमयै मंत्र धारिभिः॥ १३॥

paragraphsIast: raṇdatī kalpamavāgatya tathāgata vihāradvāre sthitaḥ evamukto āyuṣmāñachāradvatīya putro bhagavantametadavocata
sarvaprathataraṃ bhagavan mañajūśrīyaṃ kumāra bhūtamāmanaprayatesma| satyaṃkilatpammañajuśrīḥ kumāra bhūto bhagavantama tadvocata
evameta bhdagavantevametasūgataḥ sarvvaprathamataramasmpāgataḥ svakodvihāśanniṣkramyayena tathāgata vihārāstenopasaṃkrāta
upasaṃkramyaikā kesthito bhagavato darśanāya parpyūpāsanāya|| tatkasyādvetostathā hibhagavanna tṛptāhaṃ tathāgata svadarśanena
vaṃdanayā parthyupāsanemaca yadavyahaṃ tathāgata svadarśanena vaṃdanayā paryyupāsanemaca yadaṇyahaṃ bhagavastathāgatamūpasaṃkramāmi
darśanāgra vandanāya paryyupāsanāya tatvarvasatvānāmarthāyamave kṣdagavaṃstathāgato dṛṣṭaṇyo vanditaṇyaḥ pathyūpāsitaṇyaḥ

gtaḥ śāntidaḥ śuddhaḥ saṃkaraḥ priyaṃ bāṃdhavaḥ aṣṭamutinnidhīśca jñāna vakṣastapāmayaḥ || aṣṭhādhyāraṃ ṣatrodyaraḥ sarvvaktaḥ śikhīsakaḥ dhudharo bhudharādhī śopatiḥ bhupatiḥ bhudharātmajaḥ || kaṃkāladhārī muṇṇīca nāgayajña pavītavāna | jamtha nāsohe nastaṃbhimāraṇaḥ kṣomavasatthatā || śuddhanī tmābtrahana prakhyādetya muṇuvibhuṣitaḥ | valitukavalitugnotho vālocāla parākramāḥ | sarvvopatta | bhūta niṣavitaḥ kākinacārasyakasyaciṃdevatāraṃ prayatchati || avatāraṃ pratilapyati nacosya bodhicittantarā yā bhaviṣyati || jātau jātau jātismarobhaviṣyati || itamo c gavonātta manāsteca bhikṣavāstaca bādhisatvā mahāsatvāsocana sarvva vitīparṣartīsadeva mānuṣā sura garuḍa kinnara mahāra gagandhardhaśca lokābhagavate bhāṣita sammayanandanviti || aryya gaṇapati hṛdayānāmadhyāraṇī parisamāptaḥ || om namo bhagavatye āryyāṃvaṣṣa vinayāṃye || evam

paragraphsIast: pathyūpāsitaṇyo yathāhaṃ paśyāmi| yathāhaṃ vande yathāhaṃ paryyūpāse evaṃ tathāgato dṛśobhavati ravanditaḥ paryyūpāsitaśca
ahaṃ ca bhagavanta sarvva satvānāṃ kṛtaśaḥ tathāgataṃ paśyāmi bhagavān āha| kathaṃ majjūśrīḥ tathāgato draṣṭhaṇyo yāvata
paryyūpāsitavyaḥ|| mañajūśrīrāha|| tathatākāreṇa tathāgata paśyāmi avikalpākāreṇānapasambhavogena
evamunutpāḍhākāriṇa tathāgataṃ paśyāmi| sāvadatrākākā reṇa tathāgataṃ paśyāmi| na ca tathātāsamadrā gacchati| evaṃ
tathāgataṃ paśyāmi na tathatā bhavati vibhavati| evaṃ tathāgata paśyami| na tathatā deśasthā pradeśasthā evaṃ tathāgataṃ
paśyāmi| na tathatā atitājāgata pratyūtpanno evaṃ tathāgataṃ paścāmi| na tathatā dvaya prabhāvitānā dvaya prabhāvitā
evaṃ tathāgataṃ paśyāmi| na tathatā saṃkriṣyate naṇyavadāyate| evaṃ tathāgataṃ paśyāmi| na tathatā utpadyate na niradhyate
evaṃ tathāgataṃ pa

varjasaṃbhavatumamaśarīraṃ sarvva satvānāñca kāya pariśuddhirbhavatu mamasarvvagati pariśudiśca mamasarvva tathāgatāmī samāśvā sanavantu || om būddha siddha bodhaya codhaya mecaya vimocaya śodhaya viśodhaya samantānamecaya samantaraśi pariśuddha sarvva tathāgata hṛdayādhiṣṭhite || om mūdra mahāmudra mahāmūdrā mantra padesvāhā || iyaṃ sākūle pūtra sarva tathāgatoṣrīṣavijayā nāmadhāraṇī mṛtyadaṇuharā pīḍā madhavināśinī || likhitvā bhūrjapatra payitranā || taco || kyacipyaitya madhokūmbhamāśitya saṃskāpya maṇula mūdrī | lājāṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇa sahamraṃ karttavyaṃ || yathā vitavāruru pataḥ | imī sarvva tathāgatoprīṣa vijayī dhajñāraṇīṃ | vācayitvānte darvvākṣate nacaitya mūrti sarvvayeta || yesyacaṃ kṛtadinoyūḥ saptasāyaḥ patyātaṣiṣyāti || ida mavoca dagavānāṃ ttaṃmanāāryyā valokiteśvaro bodhisatvo mahāsatvaḥ sācasarvvāvatīparṣatsadeva mānūṣā sūraścalāko bhagavatābhā

vitamatyanandanniti || āryyaṣnīvijayamāntāmadhāraṇī parisamāptāṃ || om namo bhagavatyai āryyapūrṣṇa suvatī tārārai || om namo amitābhāya tathāgatāyārhatesamyakkaṃ būddhāya || namo dharmmāyā namomahāsyāthamaprāpataya || vāmanetyīnemesthāmitvāṃnasasyāmivā mane || bhagavatipiśācipūrṇṇa savaripāśa paraśudhāriyā niphakānidabhayānpūtyakṣyante || yānimāni cinmahāmāyāryakecidūpadravāḥ sabūddhā vā tyadyante || sarvāṇitāni vālatai nravātyadayante || tena pāṇtitastadane nastyanasatye vacanenaṃ || jajajaja || etiḥ yantritādhiṣṭhitairmantra padairmasarvvasatvāścarakṣāṃkuru | parimrarhakurūśāntiṃsvastyayarnayaṇu parihārraśamtra parihāraṃviṣadū ṣaṇaṃkuru | agniparihāraṃkuru | udakaparihāraṃ || kāravārddacchedanaṃkurūśīmāvandhakuru || tadayathā || om amṛte amṛtādrave | amṛtasaṃbhave avīṃste aśvaste gemāgara māsara śama

paragraphsIast: śyāmi| e vaṃcatathāgatodṛṣṭobhavati| vanditaḥ paryyūpāsitaśca| evamukte bhavagan magjuśrīyaṃ kumāra bhutametadavocata
evaṃ paśa tvaṃ magjuśrīkiṃ paścati|| magjuśrī rāha|| evaṃ na paśyanta haṃ bhagavanna kiṃgcita paśyāmi| evamahaṃ
bhagavanpaśyanna kāsyacid rmmasthātyā davaṃśyāmi| naniva rodhaṃ paśyāmi| prathā yuṣmācchara dvitīya putrā magjuśrīyaṃ
kumāra bhutametadavocata|| duṣkarakārakast va magjuśra-īryastvaṃ tathā gatamamavaṃpaśyāsi|| evaṃ payyūpāse yasyavate sarva
satvānāmānti ke mahāmaitrī pratyu presthitānacate kācitsatve palādhiḥ satvābhinivaśovā sarvasatvā
parinirvvāṇāyacāsi pratipannanacate kaścitsatvā bhininiveśaḥ| prarvalate sarvasatvānācatennataśaḥ sannāhaḥ sanda-adhaḥ
sa cā nūpalamhayogena yāvatāvayogena| evamukte muñajuśrīḥ kumāra bhūta āyuṣmanta śāradvātīya putramaitadavocata

praśame sarvvā kāla mṛtyanupaśama sarvvanakṣatra grehadoṣānupaśama sarvva drīṣṭraṇaśvo paśama bhagavati śiciparṇṇasavari || tunna vitunna tuna bhūmule svāhā || om piśāci parṇṇaśavari hrīṃ hūṃ phaṭa piśāci svāhā || āryyaparṇṇaśavarī mahāmārī praśamanīnāmadhāraṇī samāpta || || om namo bhagavatye āryya mārīcyai || evaṃ mayā śrutame kasminsamaye bhagavāna śrāvassyāṃ viharatisma || jetavane'nāthapiṇḍadasthārāme mahātā bhikṣu saṃghena sārdhva mardhva trayodaśa mibhikṣaśataiḥ saṃpakṣalaiśca boddhisatvermahāsatveḥ || tatrakhalu bhagavāna bhikṣa nāmantrayatesma || asmibhikṣa vomārīcīnāma devatā sārsyyācandramasoḥ puratongachati ya || sānadṛśātenagaghate | navadhyatena || namudhyatena || namukhyate | namudhtate || nadaṇḍāte namudyate

nṛgraha piḍānivāra sarva tathāgatādhiṣṭā nādhiṣṭate samaya svāhā || om svāhā || hūṃ svāhā || hrīṃ svāhā || dhṛḥsvāhā || dhīḥsvahā || om ādityāya svāhā || om somaya svahā || om dharaṇīsutrāya svahā || oṃ buddāya svahā || om brahaspataye svahā || om śukrāya svahā || om śaniśvāra svāhā || om rāhavai svāhā || om ketave svāhā || om buddhāya svāhā || om vajrapāṇaye svāhā || om padmadharāya svāhā || om kumārāya svāhā || om sarvagrahāṇā svāhā || om sarvanakṣatrāṇāṃ svāhā || om sarvepadravā sarva vighneyarhuṭha paṭha svāhā || imānivajrapāṇe gṛhamātṛkā nāmadhāraṇī kārtke māsaṃ śukrapakṣe saptamimāratyaṣoṣadhike bhūtvāyācavaccatṛdaśī graha nakṣatra maṇṛladine dine saptavārānuccārayitavyaṃ || tataḥ pūrṇamāsyā mahārātraṃ pūkrāṃkṛtvā vācayakasya navanavati varṣāṇi mṛtyū bhayena bhavati | alkāpāta grahapīḍā bhayaṃ bhaviṣyati || kṣātaukṣātauja tismarai bhaviṣyati || athate sarva grahā sādhu bhama

navīkṛtemūkhavidhṛtavyagranitināmaśiḥ || dhṛmādhṛmasadhūrīnyasadṛśādhrumābhavarṇṇavayūketukoṭisajotiśraṣāśarīreyūchāgra bhūṣāgaśāḥ katavekāśabhūtāyakhaṅgayāśahastayakhaṅga kūladevatāyajaja mārasya āyarorogyasaṃpadaṃ || vajapāvyāha || om dhṛmāṃbharsanibhāyakyatiketave namaḥ || lokānāṃhitārthāyanomnoroga sarvavyādhiviśeṣayeta || grahāśca bhagavana raudrārudrarupāścakūrokūra citāścate atvānīna vighnyektisma || ojoharaṃtidravyamapaharaṃtismake pāñcitprāṇamapadaraṃtisma || ṣāñciddīdaryāyasatvāmalyā yūṃkūrvvantisma || eva sarvasatvānāmpadravanavāhayaṃtisma || pūnarapina vayadidhādaśarānāṃ sarvāpadravānāṃ || tadyathā || om būddha suddha vaja padme sara prasara sāra krīḍya sarvavignāna kuru mamakāryyācchindaya sarva dūṣṭānakṣapaya śānte dāpaya drutaṃdarśayānmārarakṣarmāsarvasatvanoñca sarvagrahanakṣatrapīḍā bhayānnivādya || bhagavati maha

māyaprasādhayasarvadṛṣṭānaśodhaya sarvaṣāṃcaṇuracaṇḍinī turu sūma mūñca havā hvayabhecābhavya ugrā ugra gape bhagavati sarvasatvānāñca manārathaṃ paripūraya sarva tathāgata samavedhiṣṭhite samaye svāhā || idamavocadbhagavānāta mahāvaja pāṇīmatyarandanniti || āryyaketugrahaśāṃtapaṇāmadhāraṇī pari samāpta || om nako viprāntakāya || viprāṃtakamahāvīra trailovighnarhatāra cilamipi gaurddhakeśasūmerucaudrāgraivapañcakapāla molitāṃnī varṇṇa śusobhitaṃ gajīgagipare sthaṃpradhtālevriṇirocarnalalāvikṣāśurekṣaṇaṃ || nāgakūṇula bhūṣitaṃnānoratna manīṣālā gṛvyadīvya praktoritaṃ sarvarakṣanasaṃpūktaṃ || ṣāṭabhūjadharaṃ nāyaṃda hina karttidaṃvara mahāmādājāgaraṃ vāmakhatvāgaṃprotraṃcarva jamaṅgara yāśadharaṃ | hastimaṣūdharaṃpāda āriḍādhapādayūgaṃhasticarmāśusobhāva, vyāghracarmākāṭhiddardha || hārārdva hālaropūraṃnāgacarmmaśusobhitaṃ dakṣiṇadigaṣṭārtha sarvvasatvaḍa dhālaraṃgītācāryya jabhāsaktaṃdūḥkhanā

paragraphsIast: kṣāmi|| so bhagavāna prajñāpāramitā bhāvanāyannakasya vidvamasya dānaṃ vā gṛhaṇaṃ vāniḥ śaraṇaṃ vāḥ so bhagavāna
prajñāpāramitā bhāvanāyānakasya vidhvarmmasyabhā nirvvāṇa vṛddhī tatkasmā dvetoḥ nahi bhagavannanutpādohī yate vāvadvate
vāyai bhavat bhāvanā sā prajñā pāramitā bhāvanā|| so bhagavata prajñā pāramitā bhāvanā yānaka śrīddharmma mutpādayati vā
nirodhayati vā| so bhagavata prajñā pāramitā bhāvanā yonakasya vidharmmasyāna tvaṃ vā purṇṇatva vā karotiyā bhagavannevaṃ
bhāvanā saivambhagavat prajñā pāramitā bhāvanā|| punaraparaṃ bhagavata prajñā pāramitā bhāvanā yānaivāvi nūpāndharmmānu prārthaya
tena prādeśikāna apitukhatu punaḥ bhagavaṃtta dāpina sākkhiteyana pārśyateyena prāthātayatra pārthyave evaṃ bhāvanā bhagavat
prajñā pāramilā bhagavat prajñā pāramitā bhāvanā evaṃ prajña pasyitā ime dharmmā agrā hame dharṇmānādi iti

saṃnamaskataṃ || advisidviprasādañcarabhairavāṇāṃnamomṛtevedaśunyaddarbhāśaraṃpoṣakṛṣṇaśumaṃñjaṃladaśakroḍhagaṇemūlakroḍarājaṃ namāmyahaṃ || itidaśakroḍadhāraṇī samāptaṃ || om namo bhagavatyai āryyāmahāsāhasrapramardaṇyai || smādamabhedaṃ || siddhasūmidṛsakhearearaścavalemahāvane jāhajaṭilaakhanemakhane laṭekharaṅgaharipiṃgale timigile timiṅgalinirmagale svāhā || sidhontumamamantu padāḥ sarva satvā nāñcaveśracapasyamahārojasyanānnāvalenaiśvaryyādhipate naca svāhā || syādbhedaṃ || akheñnakhevinakhevandhovarāśecapalevūkhevakhane aścinaṃvalebhage bhagandare vaśevaśavarttiṇisvāhā || mūcyantu mamasarvvasatvānāñca sarvagrahetyaḥ dhṛtarāṣṭrasya mahārājasyanāmnābalenaiścaryyādhipate na ca svāhā || syāddyabhedaṃ || kha kha kha me khalane khalā me khalali khe khaṭakhe khaṭine kharalikhara khi karāne karaṭa kālakāminividhali | vidhiyo vidheyā śayano samavato śamiśa

paragraphsIast: na vitāṃ dhammānu palabhate|| yeṣī dharmmāṇāma gratāvāhinatā vāspāta|| evaṃ prajñā pāramitā bhāvanāyo gāna vakraḥ
kūpaputra sarvadharmmānnoya labhatona bhagavana prajñā pāramitā bhāvanā kayi adhvarmma mugraṃvāhīrna vākalyayati|| tatyasmā
dvetornna bhagavanna nuspāda spākayi adagramvānādi tathatā bhūta krodhā vā yāvatsarvva dharmmāṇāṃ kiyi adagramvā eva bhāvanā
bhagavat prajñā pāramitā bhāvanā|| eva mukre bhagavanta jaśriyaṃ kumāra bhūta meta davoyata| na punaḥ maṃjuśriragrā buddha
dharmāḥ|| maṃjuścirāha|| agrākyatvā bhagavannāgrā buddha dharmmāḥ| tātkri puna bhagavata sarva dharmā śrūnyā iti tathāgate
nābhi saṃthūghāḥ|| bhagavānāha|| eva metatmajuśrīḥ śranyāḥ sarvva dharmmā tathāgatenābhi saṃbuddhāḥ|| maṃjuśrīrāha

viṣaṃgisigūpatena bhojanamūpanomitaṃ | prātigṛhyatataḥśāstā nirviṣīkṛta bhojataṃ || etena satyavākyena amṛtabhavantu bhojanaṃ || viśvīnoda vatāyāḥ śikhino viśvabhavasthā | krakuchanda prasannāśvadevatayā mahābalāḥ kanakākhyasthadevendraḥ śrīmataḥ kāśyasthaca prasannāḥ śākyasiṃhasthatrakṣyendrā brida śekharāḥ || catvārolo kapālāścamonibhadro maheśvarāḥ rākṣasīca mahākālīca caṇḍacaṇḍa linītathā || idaṃpūṣpaṃca gandhañca pratigṛnhantu mamāhutiṃ | prīnitāḥ pūjitābhūtvā etesvadhyantu bhojanaṃ || vañjāmiṣeṇa sasṛṣṛma saṃsṛṣṭakaro tume | pañca | miṇeṇasaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ sarvvabhūjā mi bhojanaṃ || sarvvabhojana saṃsṛṣṭāaṃsaṃsṛṣṭa karātume || chinnaṃdagdhaṃ yathāsūtraṃ tātṛśaṃ bhavate pūnaḥ | tathābhojana saṃsṛṣṭa karotume || sthāyathedaṃ || khakhame khakhakhakha bhūkha khimaśive | śiśimeśihū meśimā

śimesvasti śānti samāgrimama saparivārasthañcamiṣaṃ samsṛṣṭayatha hārenirāmiṣāṃyenadagdha yathā sūtraṃ satyaṃkūrvantu tādṛśaṃsthādathedaṃ kalame kalale khalame agnisaṃkrāmanisvāhā || vipaśvibūddhaśaraṇaṃ upaiti śikhiṅca būddha sūgatañca viśvabhuṃ krakrachandabūddha kanakamūniñca kāśyapaṃ viśaradaśākya mūniñca gautama || etāsaptanarottamānāṃ pūṣpaiśvagandhaiścaśarīrapūjāṃ | kāyenateṣā menasāca bhontu prasannacitta śaraṇacaraṇamūpaiti || eteṣubuddheṣūmaharddhikeṣū || yādevatāsanti abhiprasannaḥ | tādevatā attamano udagrārakṣantume adyapradā pramattāḥ || svastyastu mamasarvva satvānāñca svāhā || ityāryya mahāsāhasrapramadardanī nāmamahāyāna sūtraṃ samāptah || om namo bhagavātyai āryya mahāmāyūryya vidyā rājajñe || namaḥ samyakasaṃbūddhabhyaḥ || samyaksabūddha nānpravarapṛthū kṛpāyā jagūḥ saptasaṃkhyānkrūthākrūro ragendrānkṣatavi

paragraphsIast: maṃjūśrīranukravā buddha dharmmā|| maṃjuśrīnātha|| eva meta bhagavanna nu marā buddha dharmmāḥ|| tatkasmā dvaśotsaṇāhī
bhagavaṃstaśva kainapi dharmāna saṃviyeteno palalate nate anubharā buddha dharmmāḥ|| punaraparaṃ bhagavat sā prajñā pāramitā
bhāvanāyāna buddha dharmmāṇā mārādhana tāyaisamvabhatena pṛthagjane dharmmāṇāṃ prahāṇāya samvarbhatatena buddha dharṇmāṇāṃ dhammaṇijaṃ
māpitrī nama manāyitrī evaṃ bhāvanā bhagavana prajñā pāramitā bha-āvanāda jūnyā yāna kaṃmpi ddharmma vinatya tena vijā
nite|| bhagavānāha|| natvaṃ maṃjuśrī buddha dharmmāśvi kayasi|| maṃjuśrī rāha| no bhagavat śvikaye yamahaṃ bhagavat buddha
dharmmāgāṃ pariniṣyatti myaśvayanna bhagavata pajñā pāramitā bha-āvanākasyāvi dharmmasyavi kalyena pṛbhu yaskita|| ime
pṛthagjana dharmmā ime śrāvaka dharmmā ime pratyeka buddha dharmmā ime samyaka buddha dharmā iti|| tatkasyā dvetosasya tameva
bhagavatanandharmma prajñā pāramitā bhāvanāṃ yogaha manuyuktaḥ

paragraphsIast: kulaputreno basabhateyasyanā dharmmāṇāṃ pṛthagjana dharmmā nirdiśata śaukra dharmmānvā nirdiśet| aśokra dharmmānvā
nirdiśet| samyakaṃ buddha dhammānvā nirdiśeta tamabhya katayo dharmmātra samanupaśāmi| evaṃ bhāvanā bhagavat pajñā pāramitā
bhāvanāna bhagavat prajñāpāramitā bhāvayo gama nuyuṃ kramya kulaputra syaivaṃbhavati| ayaṃ kāma dhārayaṃrūpadhā-ū rayamārūppa
dhā-ūyo vadya nirodha dhā-ūritī| tatkasmā dvatosya tatha-ādisa bhagavanta kaśvidhammāyo nirodha dharṇma sanupaśyāmi
evaṃ bhāvanā bhagavana pajñā pāramitā bhāvanā veditayāḥ|| puraparaṃ bhagavanne trāsa prajñā pāramitā bhāvanā yānakasyavi
dharmmasyāya kāramvā apakāramvā karoti| nahi bhagavata prajñā pāramitā bhāvanā buddha dhammāṇāṃ dātrīna pṛthagjana dharmmāṇāṃ
māchethī| evaivasā bhavavat prajñā paramitā bhāvanā| yaulaiva pṛthagjana

ni svāhā || muci svāhā || namuci svāhā || muruci svāhā ||vegagati svāhā || sarvatathāgatamūrte pravaravigate bhayasamayasvame bhagavati sarvapāpa svasti bhavantu mama sarvasattvānājya svāhā || om muni vimuni dharicali calane vegavati bhayavigate bhayahāriṇi || bodhi bodhaya buddhira cumbini sarvatathāgata hṛdaya, jaṣṭe svāhā || om munira munivare abhiṣiñca tu māṃ sarva sattvānāñca sarvatathāgatāḥ sarvavidyābhiṣekarmahakavacamudrāmuditaiḥ sarvatathāgatahṛdayādhiṣṭhite vaje svāhā || samantajvālā mālā viśuddhi sphuritacintāmaṇi mahāmudra | hṛdayā parājitā nāma dhāraṇī || atra mantrapadāḥ siddhāḥ sarva karmaparāḥ śubhāḥ || om amṛtavare vara vara pravara viśuddhe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā || om amṛtavilokī nigarbhbhasaṃrakṣaṇi ākarṣaṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā|| apārājitā hṛday || om vimale

amṛta hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā || om bhava saṃbhara indriyavalaviśodhane hūṃ hūṃ ru ru ca ce svahā | om maṇidharivajrīṇi mahāpratisare hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ svahā || upahṛdaya vidyā || ārya mahāpratisarāyāḥ prathamaḥ kalpa samāptaḥ || || atra mantrapadāsiddhāḥ samyakkaṃ buddhenabhāṣitāḥ || namo buddhāya | namo dhammāya | namaḥ saṃghāya || namo bhagavate śākya munaye mahākāruṇi | kāyatathāgatāyārhate samyakkaṃ buddhāya || namaḥ samantebhyaḥ samyakkaṃ buddhebhyo bhāvanaināṃ namaskṛtya buddha śāranevaddhaye || alamidānīṃ pravakṣāmi sarva satvānūkampajā || īmāṃ vidyāṃmahātejāṃ mahābalaparākramāṃ || yasyāṃ bhāṣita mātrāyāṃmūnināvajama yāśane || mārāśca mārakāyā racagrahāḥ sa

paragraphsIast: bhagavān āha|| na tvaṃ maṃjuśrīḥ buddha dharmma sāṃsthitāḥ|| maṃjūśrīrāha|| kaścit pūnaḥ bhagavan dharmma upalabhyate yo na
buddha dharmma saṃsthitaḥ|| bhagavan āha|| kasya punaḥ maṃjuśrīrete buddha dharmmāḥ|| iti maṃjūśrīrāha|| bhagavata evatāvadate
buddha dharṇmā iti nāmana saṃvidyente| nopasatya te kutaḥ pūnare'ṣāma bhaviṣyānti|| bhagavānāha|| prāptāte maṃjuśrī rasa'ta
maṃjūśrīrāha|| takṣathā tāvadahaṃ bhagavana sa'tai va tatkiṃ bhūyohama saṅatā manūprāpyasyami|| bhagavānāha|| viṣaṇṇo
tatkin si maṃjūśrī bodha-imaṇḍo maṃjūśrīrāha|| bhagavān navatābaddhodhi maṇaniṣarṇṇaḥ kathaṃ pūnarahaṃti ṣatsyāmi
bha-ūtakoṭi pramāṇīkṛtya|| bhagavānāha|| bhūtakoṭiriti bhagavan satkāyasyai tadadhivacanaṃ|| bhagavānāha|| kiṃ

svasti sarvvāṇi bhūtāni sarvvakālaṃdiśantuvaḥ || buddha puṣṇanū bhāvena devatā nāma satena nāyā'tha samābhapataḥ sabodhdhodyasahaścatāṃ | svasti bodhdhī padebhontu svasti vomtucatuṣpade || svastivāvrajatomārgge svasti pratyāgata ṣūrya || svasti rāḍau svastidivātvā smitanadyedine | sthite sarvatra svasti vo montu mācaiṣā pāpamāgata || sarvve satvā sarve prāṇāḥ sarvva bhūtāñca kevalaḥ || sarvai sukhinah santu sarva santu nirāmayā | sarva bhadrāṇi paśyantu mākaści tyo pamāgata || pānīṭa bhūtāni sanāgatāṇi sthitā nibhūmāvathavārikṣe | kurūvvantu maitrinatabhaya sudivāca rāyovacarantu dharmmaṃ || || iti tatra buddhānāṃ buddhāna bhāve devatā nā devatā nu bhāvena mahatīvyapaśāntoti

āryyamarakṣā mahāmantrānusāriṇī mahāvidyārājñī parisamāptā || || om namobhagavatyai āryya mahāpratyaṃṅirāyai || eva mmayā śṛtamaikasmitsameya bhagavāna deveṣutrayatti śeṣu viharatisma || sudharmmāyāṃdeva sabhāyāṃmahatā bhikṣū saṃghena sārdhdha pañcamātrai bhikṣaśatraiḥ | mahātāca bodhi satvagaṇena sārddhaḥ smitansamaye samvahulai deveṣu bhagantaparyyuṃ pīśayantisma || tatrakhalu bhagavāna | buddhāsanvahuṇṇā | kośādimānimanupadāniśca rasisma || namobhagavate aparitā guṇa pratibhāna vyuhātīta kalpāya | ta | tathāgatāyārhate samyaksaṃ buddhāya || namo bhagavate guṇaratna śrī vyūha te jorāśikalpāyatathāgatāyarhate samyasaṃ buddhāya || namobhagavate dharmma

dharaniSamgrahaSections.titleIast: Dhāraṇī Saṃgraha (62): nāsteca bhikṣa va bodhisatva mahāsatvasāca sarvāvatīparṣatsa deva mānuṣā sura garuḍa gandharvaśca loko bhagavato | bhāṣitama tyanandanniti
paragraphsIast: tkāyaḥ naiṣasaṃkrāmiti na asatkāyaḥ|| atha āyuṣmāna śāradvatapūtrā bhagavantametada vocata|| kiyatāsta bhagavan
bodhisatvā mahāsatvā bhaviṣyanti bodhayeya-imaṃ prajñā paramitā nirdeśaṃ śrutvā dhimokṣante nātra siṣyanti na sanprā
samopatsyante|| atha khalū maiteyo bodhīsatvo mahāsatvo bhagavānā metadavoca|| āsan nibhūtāste bhagavan
bodhisatvā mahā mahā bhaviṣyanti bodhāya ye imaṃ prajñā pāramitā nirdeśaṃ śrutvā adhimokṣante nauntra siṣyanti na santrā
samopatsāna te|| tadakasmādadhetoreṣaiva bhagavanparamobodhiyaiṣāṃ dharmmāṇāmanū bodhanā|| atha khalū maṃjūśrīḥ kumāra bhūto
bhagavan tametadavotva|| buddhā eva te bhagavan bodhīsatvā mahāsatvā dṛṣṭaṇyāya imaṃ prajāpāramitā siṣyaṃti na sanprā
samāpatsyente

rārevācīrīkāmābhi likhitvā kaṇṭhevandhayitavyā || eteṣāsarvva siddhi | sarva rogo padṛvāścova upanāmayiṣyanti || om hūṃ om hūṃ mama sarvva satvānāñca rakṣāṃ kurū svāhā || om vajrapāṇi hūṃ phaṭ || om sarva tathāgatoṣṇīṣa avalikite yurddhite jorāsi || om jvala prajvala dhaka baddha vidhra chinda bhinda hūṃ phaṭ || om sarvva tathāgatoṣṇīṣaśītāta patra om huṃ svāhā || tadayathā || om anale acale khasame vīre saumye sarva buddhā nādhiṣṭhile sarva tathāgatoṣlīṣa śītāta patre sarva duṣṭa prabuṣṭhānāṃ hūṃ phaṭ svāhā | om huṃ māṃ huṃ nāṃ svāhā || sarvva buddha bodhisatvānātrya sarvāya dṛve ṣusarggeśu tri japtavyā iti | itamavocattabhagavānā nābhatama

nāsteca bhikṣa va bodhisatva mahāsatvasāca sarvāvatīparṣatsa deva mānuṣā sura garuḍa gandharvaśca loko bhagavato | bhāṣitama tyanandanniti || āryā sarvatathāgatoṣṇīṣa śitātapatrenāmāparājitā mahāpratyaṃgirā mahāvipyā rājñī parisamāptaḥ || vijayavāhi || || om namo bhagatyaiāryya mahāmāyā vikṣayavāhinye || evaṃ mayā śutamekasminsamaye bhagavāna vaiśravaṇayuryyāṃ suvarṇṇaṃ śṛṃge parvata śikhare viharatisma | anekai devanāgayakṣa gandharvvā sūra garuḍa kinnara maroraga viharatirapsarā dibhistuyamānā dharmmā loka mukhaṃnāma dharmmaparyyā yaṃ deśayāmāsa | athanārāyaṇo surairjitaḥ
